about: One card for each dynamic of the atlas (theories/becoming/results/atlas/entries/dynamics.json), AI-written on 11 November 2026: which kinds of role and tie of web.json its theorems speak of, in its own model's words; its principal theorems, each read from its Lean statement and said in role-words (what it concludes, under which sameness, in which form, of which courses, how strongly, with the line of the statement as evidence); built cases worth showing; and what the map's kinds do not hold of it. Each card was written by one AI reader and put to a second to refute against the Lean statements (148 corrected, 35 kept); a review before landing corrected the wording of a few sentences more and re-filed three theorems, as the round's record lists. A card adds no result and changes no entry: the atlas and the Lean say what is proved.

cards.plain_en: Where each state has one next state, a state is drawn into a region never left exactly when its course never comes back to it; once in, always in.
cards.plain_zh: 每个状态只有一个下一状态时，一个状态恰在它的进程再也不回到它的时候，被吸入某个只进不出的区域，进去了就不再出来。

cast.as: a configuration and its course under a determined law; a region the law never leaves (absorbing); a run of a process and a region every move keeps (invariant)
cast.lean: next : S → S, Law.orbit, Law.Absorbing, Law.Drawn, Law.Returns; Run P, Invariant P R, AbsorbingUnder P R a

laws.sameness: at that configuration again, or not
laws.then_en: A configuration is drawn into some region the law never leaves exactly where its course never again is at it, for good.
laws.then_zh: 一个构型被吸入某个律永不离开的区域，恰在其进程永不再回到它之处。
laws.evidence: theorem drawn_iff_not_returns {next : S → S} {s : S} : Drawn next s ↔ ¬ Returns next s (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: at its starting configuration again, or not
laws.then_en: From the step at which its course is in the region, the course is never again at the configuration it started from, for good.
laws.then_zh: 自进程进入该区域之步起，进程再不处于起始构型，永不回来。
laws.evidence: theorem DrawnInto.never_back (absorbing : Absorbing next R) {s : S} (outside : ¬ R s) {n : Nat} (enters : R (orbit next s n)) : ∀ k, orbit next s (n + k) ≠ s (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: From a step inside the region on, no configuration of the run is one at which it was outside the region, for good.
laws.then_zh: 自处于区域之内的一步起，进程的构型再不是它在区域之外时的任何一个，永远如此。
laws.evidence: theorem Run.locked_in (r : Run P) {R : S → Prop} (invariant : Invariant P R) {n m : Nat} (inside : R (r.state n)) (outside : ¬ R (r.state m)) : ∀ k, r.state (n + k) ≠ r.state m (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: Leaving the region between one step and the next shows that the move taken there does not keep the region.
laws.then_zh: 前一步在区域之内、下一步在外，则这一步所取的动作不守该区域。
laws.evidence: theorem Run.leaving_needs (r : Run P) {R : S → Prop} {n : Nat} (inside : R (r.state n)) (leaves : ¬ R (r.state (n + 1))) : ¬ AbsorbingUnder P R (r.act n) (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: On two configurations, a run leaves a region at its first step by a move that does not keep it.
Under counting on, zero is drawn and the law merges nothing: without a finite list, drawn needs no merge.
Under counting down, one is drawn while every number can still be had at every step.

cards.misfit: Legend: no role is named. The main theorem is an iff between two predicates of one course (drawn; not returning), with no amount or time, so it is a tie holding both ways and not a border; the record itself calls it near-definitional (the region used is the configuration's own course ahead). The atlas gives no 'takes' for the exit theorem Run.leaving_needs, so its main_ifs is empty: its Lean hypotheses are inside at step n (the ledger's run-inside) and outside at step n + 1 (no ledger id). Merges.draws holds only up to double negation, which no form marks.

cards.plain_en: Where each state has one next state, courses that meet form a basin; with finitely many states every course enters a cycle within that many steps, one cycle per basin.
cards.plain_zh: 每个状态只有一个下一状态时，相遇的进程同属一个流域；状态有限，则每条进程在少于状态个数的步数内进入循环，每个流域恰有一个循环。

cast.as: configurations and their courses under one determined law; two courses meeting (at one configuration at some steps); a configuration that returns
cast.lean: next : S → S, Law.orbit, Law.Meet, Law.Returns

laws.sameness: at one configuration at some steps (meeting)
laws.then_en: The courses of the first and the third configuration meet: at some steps they are at one configuration.
laws.then_zh: 第一与第三个构型的进程相遇：在某些步上处于同一构型。
laws.evidence: theorem Meet.trans {next : S → S} {x y z : S} : Meet next x y → Meet next y z → Meet next x z, with Meet next x y := ∃ n m, orbit next x n = orbit next y m (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: at that returning configuration, or not
laws.then_en: The course is at that returning configuration at some step.
laws.then_zh: 该进程在某一步处于那个返回的构型。
laws.evidence: theorem Meet.reaches_returning {next : S → S} {x b : S} (meet : Meet next x b) (returns : Returns next b) : ∃ j, orbit next x j = b (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: at a returning configuration, or not yet
laws.then_en: At some step the course is at a returning configuration; any two returning configurations whose courses meet it lie on each other's course.
laws.then_zh: 该进程在某一步处于一个返回的构型；凡进程与它相遇的两个返回构型，各在对方的进程上。
laws.evidence: theorem basin_one_cycle (every : ∀ x, x ∈ all) (x : S) : (∃ n, Returns next (orbit next x n)) ∧ ∀ a b, Meet next x a → Meet next x b → Returns next a → Returns next b → ∃ j, orbit next a j = b (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

laws.sameness: at a returning configuration, or not yet
laws.then_en: The course is at a returning configuration at some step below the number of listed configurations.
laws.then_zh: 该进程在小于所列构型个数的某一步，处于一个返回的构型。
laws.compare_en: The step at which the course is at a configuration that returns, against the number of listed configurations: some such step is below that number.
laws.evidence: theorem enters_returning_within {next : S → S} {all : List S} (every : ∀ x, x ∈ all) (s : S) : ∃ n, n < all.length ∧ Returns next (orbit next s n) (Becoming/Attraction.lean)

cards.misfit: Legend: no role is named. Meet.trans is a theorem on a relation between courses (meeting is transitive; with Meet.refl and Meet.symm an equivalence); no form fits a theorem on a relation, and it is given as a tie whose conclusion is a meeting at some steps. 'Is at a configuration at some step' has no mark: begins is the nearest, used for all three ties. basin_one_cycle's second half (any two returning configurations of one basin lie on each other's course: one cycle) is a uniqueness that no form or mark holds; that the course goes on returning from that step is not in its statement. enters_returning_within is a bound, not an iff: border is the nearest form; its bound is the length of the list, which is the number of configurations only where the list has no repeats. The frames have none for several courses of one law.

cards.plain_en: Where courses branch, a state is lost for good on every path exactly when no path leads back to it; lost on some path, it may still return on another.
cards.plain_zh: 进程有分岔时，一个状态在每条路上都一去不回，恰在没有任何一步能通回它的时候；只在某条路上失去的，还可能从别的路回来。

cast.as: a configuration of any process, the runs and courses from it, what can be had from it, and a region the process never leaves
cast.lean: Process S A, Run P, Reach P s t, Invariant P R, Branching.Returns P s, Branching.NecessarilyDrawn, Branching.PossiblyDrawn

laws.sameness: can be had again after a step from it, or cannot
laws.then_en: A configuration is drawn, on every run, into some region the process never leaves exactly where no step from it leads back to it.
laws.then_zh: 一个构型在每条进程上都被吸入某个过程永不离开的区域，恰在从它出发没有一步能通回它之处。
laws.evidence: theorem necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns {s : S} : NecessarilyDrawn P s ↔ ¬ Returns P s, with Returns P s := ∃ a t, P.step s a t ∧ Reach P t s (Becoming/Branching.lean, Becoming/Recurrence.lean)

laws.sameness: can be had again, or cannot
laws.then_en: A configuration is possibly drawn into a region never left exactly where some course from it leads where it cannot be had again.
laws.then_zh: 一个构型可能被吸入某个永不离开的区域，恰在从它出发有某条进程通到再也得不到它之处。
laws.evidence: theorem possiblyDrawn_iff {s : S} : PossiblyDrawn P s ↔ ∃ t, Reach P s t ∧ ¬ Reach P t s (Becoming/Branching.lean)

laws.sameness: what can be had from it
laws.then_en: Everything that can be had from one configuration can be had from another exactly where the other leads back to the first.
laws.then_zh: 从一个构型可得的一切，从另一构型也都可得，恰在后者能通回前者之处。
laws.evidence: theorem keeps_reach_iff_returns {s t : S} : (∀ u, Reach P s u → Reach P t u) ↔ Reach P t s (Becoming/Labelled.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: On two configurations, one is possibly but not necessarily drawn into a region never left, and it returns.
A constant reading gives the same answers before and after a step that has no way back.

cards.misfit: Legend by its principal theorems (any process, no role). Two side declarations do name roles and are not written up: Law.perturbation_drawnInto has configurations made of a state and a rule on which alone the next depends (it could sit at rule), and the witness constant_reading_hides_loss speaks of a reading. 'Necessarily' and 'possibly' are every run and some course from one configuration, set against each other; the frames keep them apart but none holds a theorem pair that contrasts them. The iffs are between predicates, not amounts or times: ties holding both ways, not borders. A dead end, having no run, is necessarily drawn vacuously; the theorem does not say that a course entering the region exists.

cards.plain_en: A state that can return cannot be lost for good without passing a juncture: a point where one step keeps it reachable and another loses it.
cards.plain_zh: 一个能回来的状态，不经过一个关节就不会永远失去：在关节处，一步之后还能回到它，另一步之后再也回不去。

cast.as: a configuration of any process and the courses from it; a juncture for it (one step after which it can still be had, one after which it cannot); keeping, the sub-process of the steps after which it can still be had
cast.lean: Process S A, Branching.Returns P s, Branching.Juncture P s x, Branching.keeping P s, Branching.Keeps Q s

cast.as: formations that take from and give to conditions: a source, which may do so differently in the two courses at the named steps, and the others, which respond through their couplings
cast.lean: source : Nat → F → Prop; L.take, L.give (Flow F C)

cast.as: conditions and their levels, balanced under the flow before step D and alike at the start in both courses
cast.lean: W.level : Nat → C → Nat (Web F C)

cast.as: a reader: a formation whose move at a configuration is chosen from what it reads through its couplings up to step D
cast.lean: g : F, obs : F → C → Prop, choose : A → Act

cast.as: the reader's answer, read from the level histories through its couplings

ties.as: the source has reached the reader by step D: a route of exchanges from the source has entered, by D, a condition that couples into the reader (TimedResponse.ReachedBy); not reached, the source lies beyond it
the reader's answer is read through its couplings up to step D: level histories alike through them give one answer (W.AlikeThroughUpTo)

laws.sameness: can still be had again, or cannot
laws.then_en: Not not: some course from the configuration to where it is lost takes a losing step at a juncture for it.
laws.then_zh: 并非没有：从该构型到失去它之处的某条进程，在它的一个关节处走了失去之步。
laws.evidence: theorem loss_passes_juncture (returns : Returns P s) {t : S} {as : List A} (path : Trace P s as t) (lost : ¬ Reach P t s) : ¬¬ ∃ y a z, Reach P s y ∧ P.step y a z ∧ Reach P z t ∧ ¬ Reach P z s ∧ Juncture P s y (Becoming/Junctures.lean; from any configuration that can have s: loss_passes_juncture_from)

laws.sameness: can still be had again after the step, or cannot
laws.then_en: On keeping's course from the configuration, a step of the process that keeping leaves out is a losing step at a juncture for it.
laws.then_zh: 在只取保留之步的进程上，被舍去的一步是失去之步，它所离的构型是一个关节。
laws.evidence: theorem keeping_removes_at_juncture (returns : Returns P s) {x y : S} {a : A} (from_s : Reach (keeping P s) s x) (step : P.step x a y) (removed : ¬ (keeping P s).step x a y) : ¬ Reach P y s ∧ Juncture P s x (Becoming/Junctures.lean)

laws.sameness: can still be had again after the step, or cannot
laws.then_en: No step from there is a losing step: after every step from there, that the configuration can still be had cannot be refuted.
laws.then_zh: 那里没有一步是失去之步：每一步之后该构型仍可得，这一点无从否定。
laws.evidence: theorem keeps_before_juncture {x : S} (keeps : ∃ a y, P.step x a y ∧ Reach P y s) (none : ¬ Juncture P s x) : ∀ b z, P.step x b z → ¬ ¬ Reach P z s (Becoming/Junctures.lean)

laws.sameness: can still be had again
laws.then_en: Taking only the steps after which the configuration can still be had, it can be had again from wherever the course from it leads.
laws.then_zh: 只取其后仍可得该构型的步，则从它出发无论到哪里，都还能再得到它。
laws.evidence: theorem keeping_keeps : Keeps (keeping P s) s, with keeping P s := ⟨fun x a y => P.step x a y ∧ Reach P y s⟩ and Keeps Q s := ∀ y, Reach Q s y → Reach Q y s (Becoming/Junctures.lean)

laws.sameness: reached by step D, or not
laws.then_en: That configuration is a juncture, and the source has, not not, reached the reader by step D.
laws.then_zh: 该构型是一个关节；到第 D 步为止，来源并非未及于读取者。
laws.compare_en: The step by which a route from the source has entered something that couples into the reader, against D, the step up to which the reader's answer is read: at or before D.
laws.evidence: theorem turned_at_juncture … (keeps : ∃ y, P.step x (choose (read W.level)) y ∧ Reach P y s) (moves : ∃ z, P.step x (choose (read W'.level)) z) (loses : ∀ z, P.step x (choose (read W'.level)) z → ¬ Reach P z s) : Branching.Juncture P s x ∧ ¬ ¬ ReachedBy L L' W obs source g D (Becoming/Junctures.lean)

laws.sameness: the move chosen at the configuration
laws.then_en: The reader's chosen move there is the same in both courses; where it loses the configuration in one, it loses it in the other.
laws.then_zh: 读取者在该处所选的动作，在两条进程中相同；在一条中失去该构型，在另一条中也失去。
laws.evidence: theorem same_step_unreached … (through : ∀ l l', W.AlikeThroughUpTo obs g l l' D → read l = read l') (choose : A → Act) (unreached : ¬ ReachedBy L L' W obs source g D) : choose (read W.level) = choose (read W'.level) ∧ ((∀ y, P.step x (choose (read W.level)) y → ¬ Reach P y s) → ∀ y, P.step x (choose (read W'.level)) y → ¬ Reach P y s) (Becoming/Junctures.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: One configuration with a step for every natural number has no juncture: many options make none.
On two configurations with two moves, one configuration is a juncture for itself: one move keeps it, the other loses it.

cards.misfit: Mixed. The juncture and keeping theorems hold of any process and name no role: they are legend, written here under 'any'. Only the two TimedResponse theorems name roles, and through them alone the dynamic meets the web, at reaches; so the card is not marked legend. The main theorem and keeps_before_juncture hold up to double negation, which no form marks; the main theorem's statement gives some course from the configuration through a juncture to the lost place and does not say it is the given trace. lpo_of_junctures_found (finding the juncture of every loss of every process gives LPO) is a calibration and fits no form. Keeping is an operation on a process (a sub-process), not a role or a tie. A source both takes and gives; it is cast under drawers. The Lean's Reach (what can be had along the process) and the tie reaches (ReachedBy) are two relations; the sentences keep 'can be had' for the first. That the reader is at the same configuration in both courses, and that its move is chosen from its answer, are supplied to the theorem, not shown.

cards.plain_en: Nothing leaves a region when no member relates to anything outside; where each step stays in or crosses out, a path from inside to outside has a crossing step.
cards.plain_zh: 区域里没有成员关联到外面，就没有东西从它出去；若每一步不是留在里面就是跨出去，从里到外的一条线上必有跨出的一步。

cast.as: any carrier, any relation on it and any region (a predicate); a closed region; a line of continuation under any class
cast.lean: R : «际» α, P : α → Prop, «不出» R P, «闭» R P, «相续» R E x y

laws.lean: Becoming.«不出当且仅当不外者闭»
laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: Nothing in the region goes out of it along the relation exactly where what is not outside the region is closed under the relation.
laws.then_zh: 沿此关系，区域之内无物出去，恰在并非在外者沿此关系为闭之处。
laws.evidence: theorem «不出当且仅当不外者闭» {R : «际» α} {P : α → Prop} : «不出» R P ↔ «闭» R (fun y => ¬ ¬ P y) (Becoming/GrammarCrossing.lean)

laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: Nothing in the region goes out of it along the relation: no member bears the relation to something outside.
laws.then_zh: 沿此关系，区域之内无物出去：没有成员与外面之物有此关系。
laws.evidence: theorem «闭则不出» {R : «际» α} {P : α → Prop} (closed : «闭» R P) : «不出» R P, with «不出» R P := ∀ x y, P x → ¬ P y → ¬ R x y (Becoming/GrammarLaws.lean)

laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: The region is not one that nothing goes out of along the relation; no step going out is named.
laws.then_zh: 该区域并非沿此关系无物出去的区域；这里不指出哪一步出去。
laws.evidence: theorem «内至外之线则非不出» {R E : «际» α} {P : α → Prop} {x y : α} (line : «相续» R E x y) (inside : P x) (outside : ¬ P y) : ¬ «不出» R P (Becoming/GrammarCrossing.lean)

laws.sameness: inside the region or outside it
laws.then_en: The line has a step from a member to something outside, reached from the line's start and reaching its end.
laws.then_zh: 线上有一步从成员到外面之物，由线的起点可达，并通到线的终点。
laws.evidence: theorem «内至外之线有出步» (split : ∀ u v, «续» R E u v → (P u → P v) ∨ (P u ∧ ¬ P v)) {x y : α} (line : «相续» R E x y) (inside : P x) (outside : ¬ P y) : ∃ u v, «续» R E u v ∧ (P u ∧ ¬ P v) ∧ (x = u ∨ «相续» R E x u) ∧ (v = y ∨ «相续» R E v y) (Becoming/GrammarCrossing.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: On two occurrences, a relation that is not symmetric has a closed region that something outside comes into.

cards.misfit: Legend: any carrier, relation and region; no role, and outside the line theorems no course in time. These theorems say what the tie crosses (出入) means for any relation; they are its legend, not a place on the web. The first theorem is an iff between two predicates of a region, not a comparison of amounts: a tie holding both ways with mark absent (nothing goes out). That every region nothing goes out of is closed is exactly excluded middle («不出皆闭当且仅当排中»); the Lean and the record call it a lemma of the stable-membership theorem («不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»), not a calibration, and no form holds it. The exit's premise, that every step keeps to the region or goes out, holds wherever membership is decided («定则内至外之线有出步») and is weaker than that; without it only 'not one that nothing goes out of' is shown. In the line theorems 'reached' is the grammar's 及 along the line (相续), not the web's tie reaches.

cards.plain_en: When nothing that carries a thing on is still active at some fixed step, it ends along every path; saying where requires deciding, point by point, whether it continues.
cards.plain_zh: 到某一步，凡接续它的都已不活动，它便在每一分支上都终止；要指出终于何处，还须逐点判定它是否有后续。

cast.as: the line from an active occurrence along a continuation R, read under a class within activity (the pattern that degenerates)
cast.lean: «退化» (Web.continuationStep R) E x, with «则» E W.activityClass

cast.as: the occurrences (a step and a formation) the line reaches, each continuing the last; in the passing regime, brief carriers
cast.lean: «所及» (continuationStep R) E x y; V.Brief d a

cast.as: a condition with a level; a family of conditions with its stock
cast.lean: W.level s c; W.stock ds T

cast.as: an occurrence that requires the condition at a need and is active only where supported
cast.lean: W.requires N y.2 c, W.need N y.2 c; W.Dependent

cast.as: the flow's uptake from the family
the flow's replenishment of the family
a line under any carrier and relations (the theorem on reaching an end), and every web and continuation (the calibration)
cast.lean: «尽» R L x; «有终» R L x

ties.as: the line goes on through occurrences continued along R; in the passing regime carriers pass the pattern on (ByPassing), and passing stops from step T
every occurrence the line reaches at step N requires the condition at a need no lower than at T, while the level stays below that need after T
the family's uptake exceeds its replenishment for n steps, from a stock below n + m
the family's replenishment, short of its uptake over those n steps

laws.sameness: active or not, at any class within activity
laws.then_en: The pattern's line from that occurrence ends on every branch.
laws.then_zh: 延续者之线自该处起，在每一分支上都终止（尽）。
laws.evidence: Becoming/MapInstances.lean: theorem every_branch_ends_of_gone (inside : «则» E W.activityClass) (start : W.active x.1 x.2) (le : x.1 ≤ N) (gone : ∀ y, «所及» (continuationStep R) E x y → y.1 = N → ¬ W.active y.1 y.2) : «退化» (continuationStep R) E x

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: The pattern's line from that occurrence ends on every branch.
laws.then_zh: 延续者之线自该处起，在每一分支上都终止。
laws.evidence: Becoming/MapInstances.lean: theorem consumed_held_degenerates (dependent : W.Dependent) (below : ∀ s, T < s → W.level s c < W.need T g c) (after : T < N) (start : W.active x.1 x.2) (le : x.1 ≤ N) (held : ∀ y, «所及» (continuationStep R) W.activityClass x y → y.1 = N → W.requires N y.2 c ∧ W.need T g c ≤ W.need N y.2 c) : «退化» (continuationStep R) W.activityClass x

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: The pattern's line from that occurrence ends on every branch.
laws.then_zh: 延续者之线自该处起，在每一分支上都终止。
laws.evidence: Becoming/MapInstances.lean: theorem family_excess_degenerates (balances : L.Balances W) (dependent : W.Dependent) (excess : ∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) (stock : W.stock ds T < n + m) (start : W.active x.1 x.2) (le : x.1 ≤ T + n) (held : ∀ y, «所及» … x y → y.1 = T + n → ∃ e, e ∈ ds ∧ W.requires (T + n) y.2 e ∧ m ≤ W.need (T + n) y.2 e) : «退化» (continuationStep R) W.activityClass x

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: The pattern's line along the passing ends on every branch from that occurrence.
laws.then_zh: 延续者沿相传之线，自该处起在每一分支上都终止。
laws.evidence: Becoming/MapInstances.lean: theorem stopped_degenerates (byPassing : V.ByPassing passes) (brief : ∀ a, V.Brief d a) (stopped : ∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬ V.PassesAt passes t) (start : V.active x.1 x.2) (le : x.1 ≤ T + d) : «退化» (continuationStep (passingContinuation passes)) V.activityClass x

laws.sameness: continued or not, under the class the line is read under
laws.then_en: The line reaches an end: some point it reaches has no continuation.
laws.then_zh: 此线有终：其所及之中有一点不再有后续。
laws.evidence: Becoming/GrammarMap.lean: theorem «尽而续可定则有终» {R L : «际» α} {x : α} (h : «尽» R L x) : (∀ y, «所及» R L x y → «有后» R L y ∨ ¬ «有后» R L y) → «有终» R L x

laws.sameness: reaches an end or not
laws.then_en: That every line meeting the head theorem's premise at the activity class reaches an end holds exactly where excluded middle holds.
laws.then_zh: 凡在活动之类上合首定理前提之线皆有终，这恰与排中律等价。
laws.evidence: Becoming/MapInstances.lean: theorem end_of_gone_iff_excluded_middle : (∀ (F' C' : Type) (V : Web F' C') (R …) (x …) (N : Nat), V.active x.1 x.2 → x.1 ≤ N → (∀ y, «所及» (Web.continuationStep R) V.activityClass x y → y.1 = N → ¬ V.active y.1 y.2) → «有终» (Web.continuationStep R) V.activityClass x) ↔ ∀ P : Prop, P ∨ ¬ P (on the grammar: «尽则有终当且仅当排中», GrammarMap.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: a built web continued exactly where P holds meets the head theorem's premise and degenerates; any end decides P (end_decides)
in one built web the held-dependence theorem's premises hold together from an active start, and the line degenerates
in the relay stopped at step T, the stopped-passing theorem's premises hold together and the first carrier's line degenerates

cards.misfit: Mixed: the head theorem holds of any web and continuation and names only a line from an active occurrence; the theorem on reaching an end holds of any carrier and relations and the calibration of every web, so these two are legend; only the three regime theorems name a stock, a dependent, drawers or carriers. All four degeneration theorems have one conclusion (the line from the occurrence ends on every branch), so their sentences nearly coincide and differ only in their ifs. 'Ends' is two predicates here that one mark does not tell apart: ends on every branch (尽) and reaches an end (有终, a point with no continuation); the dynamic is the gap between them. The calibration against excluded middle is a statement about logic and fits no form ('same-as' is the nearest). In the built cases activity is given, so they show the premises hold together, not that a regime ends a line. No exits or transitions: all six are mechanism theorems (the head theorem, its three regime cases, and two on reaching an end), more than the three a card usually leads with.

cards.plain_en: Where what gives back to a stock itself needs it, a level once below that need gets nothing back, stays below, and leaves whatever needs it inactive.
cards.plain_zh: 补给存量者自身也需此存量时，水平一旦落到所需之下，便得不到补给，一直留在其下，需它的也就不再活动。

laws.sameness: level at or above m

laws.then_en: A level below m at step T is below m at every later step.

laws.then_zh: T 步之后仍活动的依者，那时对此存量的所需已低于 T 步时，或已不需。

built_cases.shows_en: without the gate: a part inactive at step 1 is active from step 2, after a renewer needing nothing gives
two built laws, the focal formation active and forming alike at every step: renewing in one, consuming in the other
a built unfolding whose support recurs without lasting is neither renewing nor consuming: the classes do not exhaust the cases

cards.misfit: One formation fills two roles: under the gate the renewer is also a dependent (so 'needs' runs from the renewer), and in the family the focal formation both draws and gives. Renewing and consuming (RenewingIn, ConsumingIn) are classes of a formation over a whole course, exclusive and not exhaustive: a definition's reading, not a statement of one tie with a mark. Joint drawing is one law with the summed draw, so 'two drawers each within renewal alone' is not a statement about two drawers in the family's model. The general theorems take the fall below the need as a premise; only the family concludes it (overdraw_crosses_support). 'Stays below' is marked absent under 'level at or above m'; it could as well be 'lasts' under 'level below m'. The ending theorem reads the dependence at each step, so it marks an end only of what still needs the stock at m or more at that step. overdraw_ends is a fourth mechanism theorem, kept because the mechanism states it as the family's result and so that 'draws on' has a theorem; the atlas's exit 1 is a built case.

cards.plain_en: Where something is active only while its needs are met, after a stock falls below its need it is active later only if the stock returns or the need weakens.
cards.plain_zh: 凡所需得到满足才能活动者，存量落到其所需之下以后，它日后仍活动，只可能是存量已回升，或其所需已减弱。

cast.as: a condition with a whole-number level; in the built case a second condition as well

ties.as: a dependence: the formation requires the condition at a need; each step keeps, breaks, forms or dissolves it (Kept, Broken, Forms, Dissolves); activity needs support (Dependent)

laws.sameness: level at or above the dependent's need at T
laws.then_en: The stock's level at that step is at or above the dependent's need at step T.
laws.then_zh: 该步的存量水平不低于依者在第 T 步的所需。

laws.then_zh: T 步之后仍活动的依者，那时对此存量的所需已低于 T 步时，或已不需。

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: The dependent is inactive at every step after T.
laws.then_zh: 依者在 T 之后的每一步都不活动。
laws.evidence: Becoming/Dependence.lean: theorem consumed_ends_when_fixed (dependent : W.Dependent) (fixed : ∀ t, T < t → W.requires t g c ∧ W.need T g c ≤ W.need t g c) (below : ∀ t, T < t → W.level t c < W.need T g c) : ∀ t, T < t → ¬ W.active t g

built_cases.shows_en: from one configuration three runs break the same dependence at the first step: one ends, one transforms, one is restored

cards.misfit: The three outcomes constrain and are neither exhaustive nor exclusive; the first two theorems are contrapositives of the premise that activity needs support, and the atlas's exits 1 and 2 are those same theorems read with the third's premise dropped, not further places. The restoring theorem has no order between T and the step read: 'earlier' is the docstring's reading. 'Transformed' covers a lowered need and a dissolved dependence alike: telling them apart (Dissolves, Forms) is finer than one tie with a mark, and the theorem does not take that the need held at T. Consumed does not require the need ever to have been met, so the 'loss' is a level staying below a need at T, with no ending shown. That the three built runs break the same dependence rests on reading the fall against the step's start, a convention no kind holds. ceases_at_a_step and arises_at_a_step hold of any property of steps (legend; form 'cannot', a double negation naming no step) and are left out of the three theorems. Dependent leaves out reserves and lags.

cards.plain_en: Under a standing draw, a stock that gives back by its level has an exact point: from below it the stock runs out; from at or above, it holds.
cards.plain_zh: 在恒定的取用之下，按自身水平给还的存量有一个确切的点：起于其下，存量终将耗尽；起于其处或其上，则守住。

cast.lean: H in RegimeMargin.step g H x = (x - H) + g (x - H)

cast.as: the regime's giving law: what the condition gives from what the draw leaves, read off the level

ties.as: the standing draw takes first at each step, as much as there is
giving from what is left: short of the draw below y, meeting it from y up to the top hi, nothing from nothing
giving stops below a need m (Gated); the point of no return is H + y, y the least level left whose giving meets the draw (Root)

laws.sameness: level above nothing
laws.then_en: From a start up to the top, the stock's level reaches nothing at some step exactly where the start is below H + y.
laws.then_zh: 起始不过上界时，存量水平在某一步为零，恰在起始低于 H + y 之时。
laws.compare_en: the start level with the point of no return H + y: the draw plus the least level left at which giving meets the draw.

laws.sameness: how far the point of no return lies above the need
laws.then_en: The least level whose giving meets the draw lies above the need exactly where giving at the need is short of the draw.
laws.then_zh: 所给抵得上取用的最低水平高于所需，恰在所需处的所给抵不上取用之时。
laws.compare_en: the least level whose giving meets the draw with the need; on the other side, giving at the need with the draw.
laws.evidence: Becoming/RegimeMargin.lean: theorem beyond_draw_iff (gated : Gated g m) (pos : 0 < H) (root : Root g H y) : m < y ↔ g m < H

laws.sameness: how far the point of no return lies above the need
laws.then_en: With the least levels meeting each draw and the joint draw a, b, c above the need, a + b ≤ c + 1.
laws.then_zh: 抵得上两份取用与合并取用的最低水平各高出所需 a、b、c，则 a + b ≤ c + 1。
laws.compare_en: the sum of the two rises above the need under each draw with the rise under the joint draw plus one unit.
laws.evidence: Becoming/RegimeMargin.lean: theorem rises_superadditive (sub : SubadditiveAbove g m) (low₁ : Lowered g g₁) (low₂ : Lowered g g₂) (r₁ : Root g₁ H₁ (m + a)) (r₂ : Root g₂ H₂ (m + b)) (r : Root g (H₁ + H₂) (m + c)) : a + b ≤ c + 1

laws.sameness: level above nothing
laws.then_en: From every start level x, the stock's level is nothing at step x.
laws.then_zh: 无论起始水平 x 是多少，存量水平在第 x 步为零。

laws.sameness: where the point of no return lies

laws.then_zh: 较大取用之下的不可回返之点，至少高出两份取用之差。

laws.sameness: level at or above b
laws.then_en: The stock's level is below b at some step up to n.
laws.then_zh: 存量水平在不晚于第 n 步的某一步低于 b。
laws.compare_en: the start level x with b + (H − Y)·n: the level b plus n times the draw less the most the stock gives.

built_cases.shows_en: draw 3 + 3 ends the stock from every level; draw 3 alone holds it from levels 6 to 8
with giving that adjusts one unit a step, recent giving carries the level across the point both ways
least levels meeting draws 4 and 8 are 2 and 6: the joint rise 14 exceeds the sum 12

cards.misfit: Three of the six theorems (beyond_draw_iff, rises_by_draw, rises_superadditive) compare giving laws and draws and have no run in their statement: no frame fits, and 'one-course' or 'two-courses' is the nearest (rises_superadditive compares three regimes, and its inequality, less one unit, is not 'more of one gives no less of another' within one regime). falls_within is a one-sided bound in amounts and steps, not an exact border: it is typed as a tie that ends, with what it compares given; its other side (not_before) is left out by the cap of six. The renewer is not a second thing: the stock gives to itself by a law of what the draw leaves, and the need is the level below which that giving stops, so 'needs' runs from the renewer to the stock with no dependent. That giving is read off the level within a regime, and how it depends on the draw, are premises (regimemargin-step), dropped only in the built case Crossing.crosses (the atlas's exit 2). 'Ends' here is the level being nothing at some step; that it stays nothing is a separate theorem (stays_ended). The theorems locate where the stock ends and order nothing.

cards.plain_en: On one model, a way of going on paired with a level that has a next only where the level meets a need, with marked levels outside which the level makes no difference to the way after a step, it is proved that the line ends where the net ends where no level that meets a positive need is marked and the level of the course as it was is given at most r and loses more than r at every step; and that, under a standing giving and use from which the course as it was comes to nothing, where the way after a marked step is of a kind every step keeps, with one standing use, the line never ends exactly where, at the first marked step of the course as it was, the need met there and before, the level one step later is at or above that kind's point of no return. The marked levels, the need and the kept kind are given, not derived.
cards.plain_zh: 在一个模型上（一种方式配一个水位，水位达到所需才有下一步；在标记的水位之外，水位对一步之后的方式没有影响）证明：所需为正、达到所需的水位都没有标记，而照旧的进程的水位每步所得至多 r、所失多于 r 时，这条线在网终止处终止；在会让照旧的进程耗尽的恒定给予与取用之下，标记之后的方式若属于每一步都保持、只有一种恒定取用的一类，这条线永不终止，恰在照旧的进程首个标记之步（该步及此前都达到所需）之后一步的水位不低于那一类的不返之点之时。标记、所需和保持的那一类都是给定的，不是推出来的。

cast.as: the way of going on: a configuration's first part, which becomes after w x after a step; outside the marked levels it becomes alone of the way, and the step with alone at every level is the step as it was; a line goes on under the class of ways, or of a kind of way

laws.then_en: Within as many steps as the starting level, the line reaches a configuration that conditions nothing, its way alone taken that many times: it ends where the net ends.
laws.then_zh: 不超过起始水位那么多步，这条线就到达一个什么也不引出的构形，其方式是 alone 施行同样多次：它在网终止处终止。

laws.compare_en: the level of the course as it was one step after its first marked step, against the kept kind's point of no return H₂ + y₂

laws.sameness: the line never ends, or it ends
laws.then_en: Where the course as it was comes below the need, the line never ends exactly where there is a first marked step T of the course as it was, the need met there and at every step before it, from whose next configuration the line never ends.
laws.then_zh: 照旧的进程若会降到所需以下，这条线永不终止，恰在照旧的进程有一个首个标记之步 T（该步及此前各步都达到所需），且从 T 的下一构形起这条线永不终止之时。

laws.sameness: the way
laws.then_en: The class of ways is constant up to the net's end exactly where no two levels that meet the need give one way two different ways after a step.
laws.then_zh: 方式之类到网终止都有常，恰在任意两个达到所需的水位不会让同一方式在一步之后成为两种不同方式之时。

built_cases.shows_en: Giving min z (12 − z), a use of five as it was and of three for the kept kind, a need of one, from the level nine (as it was the level runs nine, eight, six, two, nothing): first marked at nine or at eight, the way turns with eight or six left and the line never ends.

First marked at six, the way turns with two left and the line conditions nothing two steps later; at six its line under the class of ways ends while the net goes on, so that class is not constant up to the net's end (Three.line_ends_while_net_goes).

cards.misfit: (1) The model has no separate readers, no rule and no overseer: there are only levels of the one quantity the going on needs, some of them marked, outside which the level's difference does not reach the way after a step (AloneOutside). The marked levels are not cast as readers or as a second population; the need is not cast as a separate dependent, the way and the level being one configuration, so 'needs' runs from the way to the level; the use is a function of the way, cast as drawers, and the giving is one function for every way, cast as renewer, though neither is a second thing in the Lean. (2) The marked levels, the need, the kept kind, that it is kept at every step (kept) and that it has one standing use (uses) are premises; the exactness of turns_in_time_iff past the first marked step rests on kept and uses. Nothing derives how what brings a level's difference to a way comes to stand, or that it stands on the level whose difference it brings. (3) 'The lock' of the neighbouring cards is here the class of a kind kept as it was: along the course that reads off the share, which is the window course as it was (join_is_asItWas), the locked configurations form a region closed under the step (locked_closed), constant up to the net's end at a locked member's class (locked_at_class). The lock's own models are identified with this one only at a need of nothing (net_zero, window_is_pair, window_agrees_until_marked), where the step is total and no line ends where the net ends; that a lock needs nothing of what it uses is how its models are built, not a result, and ends_with_net and the split at the first marked level do not apply to them. (4) toEnd_iff concerns the relation, not a run: no frame fits, and one-course is the nearest. The two endings, where the net ends (ends_with_net) and while the net goes on (kind_ends_while_net_goes), are both filed as form tie with mark ends; the map's marks do not tell them apart. (5) The theorems on reading in time on their own model (ReadOffInTime) are not joined; the level of the course as it was is not identified with DrawHistory.underDraws, and the closed form of the first marked step is not stated. (6) Left out of the theorems: ends_with_net_regime (the regime meets ends_with_net's premises), unending_iff_above, kind_not_toEnd_of_turn, constant_iff_needs_nothing (given some way, the class of ways is constant exactly where nothing is needed and no level makes a difference), agrees_until_marked, and the root's ties in GrammarPath («局定后则至终有常当且仅当同行可决», «有常当且仅当至终有常可续» and their parts) and GuardedStep (Law.stepWhile_toEnd_iff, Law.stepWhile_unending_iff).

cards.misfit: leading_exact (with leading_falls) holds of any down-closed fate of whole-number levels with an exact check and names no role: legend inside a dynamic otherwise about one stock under a draw; the mechanism states it first, and it is listed after the theorem on the stock because the place on the map is the stock's threshold. The stock's state has two coordinates, level and recent giving, and the threshold is a curve in that plane; the kinds give a stock one level, so the recent giving has no role of its own and sits in the words of 'gives back'. 'Comes to rest below the draw' is a fate of the whole run, decided at step 3·hi + 3, not a mark at a step, and at such a rest the level need not be nothing (rests_short). threshold_regime joins this model to the regime's point H + y by proof and has no run in its statement, so its frame is only the nearest. The theorems hold within a band the step keeps and for giving that rises with what is left and with the recent giving; beyond the band they are silent, and without the rising no level separates the fates (Notch). Five mechanism theorems, more than the three a card usually leads with.

cards.misfit: The theorems bound the weight of the courses of ONE process (two values, weights p and q, independent steps, balanced by construction) on which the level falls to the need: a one-way bound on a weighted share of courses. No frame holds it ('every-course' is nearest, but a case must supply the process and many runs, or the weights) and no form ('border' is nearest; it is not an iff). record_share is an equality of two shares, filed as 'alike': the share is unmoved by all of the record but the margin it shows and the steps it leaves; where the record weighs nothing both record theorems say nothing. In the Lean the objects are weighted lists of two values; 'level' and 'need' are the reading the definitions' names give, and nothing of a dependent is modelled. The bound theorems take no premise. The Lean and the atlas say the level 'reaches' the need; the card says 'falls to' (the Lean's fallsTo), since 'reaches' is the map's tie for coupling. fallsTo_succ (a break is falling to the need from m + 1) is a definitional unfolding and is not listed among the card's theorems.

cards.misfit: The main theorems bound a count of consecutive active steps by a level (a deadline). Written as 'tie, ends', but the Lean gives only the bound: activity stops at some step within level + 1 steps, not that it stays stopped. 'Supported' is a statement about the renewer's own needs tie used as a condition on a gives-back tie, and 'fed by' joins a gives-back and a needs tie; neither has a kind of its own. Flow.fed_beyond_level_at has no 'takes' entry in the atlas, so its main_ifs is empty (its hypotheses read as flow-balanceson-family-over-stretch, flow-giverssupported, requiring and taking at each step, and the level at T below n); it exhibits a giver to some condition the drawer requires, not named as c. persists_consuming's takes are listed under substitution-preserves-consumption, not under this dynamic; it concludes four things of two roles at once, and one mark holds only the focal drawer's part. Exits 2 and 3 and Redundant.withheld_both are witnesses; Overshoot.steady_continues and withheld_both are not among the three shown.

cards.misfit: 'Consuming' (ConsumingIn) is a class of a drawer that joins two ties: it draws on a stock, and some dependence on that stock is never met again; it asks only for one such draw and says nothing of the drawer causing the loss. No tie kind holds the join; it is filed under draws-on. The main theorem quantifies over every web differing in one thing (the drawer's own dependence from T₀ on) and is an iff: 'alike' with an exact condition, which the form 'alike' does not say. The ability to change dependence is written into the model (dependence chosen by support), a modelling choice; the alternative's level is constant. The whole-run and stepwise readings are two samenesses of one drawer; the stepwise one appears only in the built cases. persists_consuming concludes four things of two roles; the mark 'changes' holds only the focal drawer's part.

cards.plain_en: If a drawn-on stock gets nothing back once another is empty, the other's end ends it too; an end runs down every chain of such dependence, a ring ending together.

cards.misfit: Every role here is filled by a stock or a bare amount: the dependent is a stock whose giving stops where another has nothing left; the 'drawers' are draws H i with nothing behind them; the 'renewer' is the stock's own giving law. Total dependence is a tie from one stock to another through a giving law; 'needs' holds it only with a stock in the dependent's place, and there is no need or margin in it ('gives-to', one's giving waiting on another's, is the other candidate; here the giving waits on another's level, not on its giving). A point of no return here is a stock's own, given the others' levels. ends_together is an iff between two endings, not in amounts: written 'tie' with strength exact. Mutual support and a band are order premises on gives-back that the marks cannot say. Not written, by the six-theorem limit: the pair's theorems of transition 1 (the web's theorems read for two), ends_after (the drain: the level falls by its draw each step and is nothing within as many steps as its level), ends_of_below, comes_to_rest, ends_iff_within (transition 2), threshold_falls_within and Recent.keepsBelow (transition 3), and Recent.adjusted, which is a 'same-as'. The witnesses MutualActivation.saves and Recent.Momentum.threshold_falls_with_recent are not among the three shown.

laws.sameness: the generation has a member or none
laws.then_en: The generation at step stock + 1 has no member: the lineage has ended by then.
laws.then_zh: 第“存量+1”步的那一代没有成员：这一支至此已亡。
laws.compare_en: the number of steps at which the lineage reproduces against the family's stock at the start
laws.evidence: (balances : ∀ t, t < W.stock ds 0 + 1 → L.BalancesOn W ds t) (dissipates : ∀ t, t < W.stock ds 0 + 1 → L.DissipatesOn ds t) : G.size (W.stock ds 0 + 1) = 0  [Becoming/Reproduction.lean]

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: Not every member of the first n generations of takers is active at its generation's step; the theorem names no member and no step.
laws.then_zh: 前 n 代取用者的成员，并非个个在其代之步仍活动；此定理不指明哪一个、哪一步。
laws.compare_en: the condition's level at the first step, plus one, against two to the number of generations (level + 1 below 2^n)
laws.evidence: (beyond : W.level T c + 1 < 2 ^ n) : ¬ ∀ j p, j < n → p ∈ G.family (T + j) → W.active (T + j) p  [Becoming/LineageRegimes.lean]

built_cases.shows_en: From the same stock, a relay never in excess generates, and a run-down in excess ends on every branch.
What gives back needs nothing of the stock: no excess, not unfed, no dissipation; every formation active at every step.
Without the gate, the line of what gives back, needing nothing, goes on at the kind grain.

cards.misfit: The conclusions are the root's 退化: a line ends on every branch, at a named grain. 'Every branch of one line' is neither one course nor every course of every process; no frame holds it and it is put as one-course. stock_forces_neither (the stock alone decides neither region) is a negative about what a premise decides, shown by two built courses from the same stock; no form holds it, and it is given through the built case both_fates. multiplying_takers_stop is a negated universal naming no member and no step: put as cannot. The draw theorems bound how long a doubling draw lasts; they do not say the line ends on the map (the record's own limit). 'Dissipated on' relates what each formation gives to what it takes and has no tie of its own. All four exits are witnesses, so none appears as a theorem. Left out by the limit of six: multiplying_takers_need, reproducing_within, closed_lineage_lowered, LineageDrawdown.below_iff (an exact ledger border).

cards.plain_en: Drawing each generation from the last, nearly every way of drawing ends with one kind alone, by its starting share when none is favoured; a favoured kind can be lost.
cards.plain_zh: 每一代都从上一代抽取而成：抽法虽多，绝大多数终归只剩一类；无所偏向时，一类占满的份额就是它起初的份额；受偏向的一类也可能失去。

cast.as: two kinds among N members (or M + 1): the count of the first kind and its share
cast.lean: Becoming.Drift.sampled N f k h; Becoming.Drift.Replacement.value M a b f k i

cast.as: the draw: each next generation N draws from the last weighted by its counts, or one member replaced at a time, up with weight a and down with weight b
a kind, fixed (all members), lost (none) or still varied
the members drawn in each generation; a sampling of n from the listed offspring

ties.as: the draw favours the first kind where the upward weight exceeds the downward (b < a), and neither kind where the weights are equal or the draw goes by the counts alone
a kind goes on only through the members drawn: each next generation is drawn from the last, or sampled from the listed offspring

laws.sameness: the first kind has a member or none
laws.then_en: From a count of nothing the histories of k generations weigh wholly on a count of nothing: the first kind does not begin again.
laws.then_zh: 起于零，历 k 代的诸历史，其权重全在零：第一类不复生。
laws.evidence: theorem sampled_none (N : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ k, sampled N f k 0 = (N ^ N) ^ k * f 0  [Becoming/Drift.lean; twin sampled_all: sampled N f k N = (N ^ N) ^ k * f N]

laws.sameness: the first kind fixed (all N) or not, after k generations
laws.then_en: After k generations the histories fixing the first kind weigh a share at most h/N and within (r/N^N)^k of it.
laws.then_zh: 历 k 代，使第一类占满的诸历史，其权重份额至多为 h/N，且与 h/N 相差不过 (r/N^N)^k。
laws.compare_en: N times the weight of the histories fixing the first kind, against h times the whole weight (N^N)^k: at most it, and with N·r^k at least it
laws.evidence: theorem fixation {N r : Nat} (two : r + 2 = N ^ N) (k h : Nat) (within : h ≤ N) : N * sampled N (fixed N) k h ≤ h * (N ^ N) ^ k ∧ h * (N ^ N) ^ k ≤ N * sampled N (fixed N) k h + N * r ^ k  [Becoming/Drift.lean; with sampled_count (no direction) and varied_vanishes (the still varied weigh at most r^k)]

laws.sameness: the first kind fixed (all M + 1) or not, after (M + 1)·m steps
laws.then_en: After (M+1)·m steps the fixing histories' share is at most the potential's ratio, start over top, and within (r/(a+b)^(M+1))^m of it.
laws.then_zh: 历 (M+1)·m 步，使第一类占满的诸历史，其份额至多为势之比（起点比顶点），且相差不过 (r/(a+b)^(M+1))^m。
laws.compare_en: the potential at the top times the weight of the histories fixing the first kind, against the whole weight (a+b)^((M+1)·m) times the potential at the start: at most it, and with the potential at the top times r^m at least it
laws.evidence: theorem fixation {r : Nat} (split : r + a ^ (M + 1) = (a + b) ^ (M + 1)) (m i : Nat) : potential M a b (M + 1) * value M a b (fixed M) ((M + 1) * m) i ≤ (a + b) ^ ((M + 1) * m) * potential M a b i ∧ (a + b) ^ ((M + 1) * m) * potential M a b i ≤ potential M a b (M + 1) * value M a b (fixed M) ((M + 1) * m) i + potential M a b (M + 1) * r ^ m  [Becoming/Drift.lean; the ratio is the starting share where a = b (neutral_share) and strictly above it from a mixed start where b < a (favoured_share_above)]

laws.sameness: the sampled share of the first kind at most the share before the step (h/N), or above it
laws.then_en: The samplings of n whose share of the first kind is at most h/N weigh, times n²g², at most N²·n·p·q·(p+q)^n.
laws.then_zh: 抽 n 个而第一类份额不过 h/N 的诸抽样，其权重乘以 n²g²，至多为 N²·n·p·q·(p+q)^n。
laws.compare_en: the weight of the samplings of n falling back to the share h/N or below, times n²g², against N²·n·p·q·(p+q)^n, the whole weight being (p+q)^n: a share falling as 1/n
laws.evidence: theorem falls_back (p q n h N g : Nat) (gap : (p + q) * h + g = N * p) : total (Typicality.courses n) (fallsBack p q n h N) * (n * n * (g * g)) ≤ N * N * (n * (p * q * (p + q) ^ n))  [Becoming/Drift.lean]

laws.sameness: the sampled share of the first kind at most the share before the step (h/N), or above it
laws.then_en: The samplings of n falling back to a share of h/N or below weigh at least q^n, at every sample size n.
laws.then_zh: 回落到 h/N 或以下的诸抽样，其权重至少为 q^n，样本大小 n 为何皆然。
laws.compare_en: the weight of the samplings of n falling back, against q^n, the weight of the samplings with no draw of the first kind
laws.evidence: theorem falls_back_ge (p q n h N : Nat) : q ^ n ≤ total (Typicality.courses n) (fallsBack p q n h N)  [Becoming/Drift.lean]

laws.sameness: the count of the first kind nothing (lost) or not
laws.then_en: From a count i of at most M, the histories of k + i steps losing the first kind weigh at least b^i·(a+b)^k.
laws.then_zh: 起于不过 M 的计数 i，历 k+i 步而失去第一类的诸历史，其权重至少为 b^i·(a+b)^k。
laws.compare_en: the weight of the histories of k + i steps that lose the first kind, against b^i times the whole weight of k steps, (a+b)^k
laws.evidence: theorem lost_ge (k : Nat) : ∀ i, i ≤ M → b ^ i * (a + b) ^ k ≤ value M a b lost (k + i) i  [Becoming/Drift.lean; no premise that b < a: the statement is of the first kind, favoured or not]

built_cases.shows_en: One of each kind, one generation: of four histories one fixes the first kind and two stay mixed.
One of each kind, up weighing two, down one: fixing histories weigh six of nine, above the starting half.
One draw from three of the first kind and two of the second: falling back weighs two of five.

cards.misfit: The theorems count histories by weight (the ways of drawing) and say nothing of which history happens. That is a weighted count over all courses of one sampling process: not one course, not two, and not every course of every process, so it is not the legend though it is put as every-course. A case would have to supply many runs, and the account supposes no chance of the unfolding. The conclusions are finite two-sided bounds on a weight; 'the share tends to' is their reading, not the Lean. They are comparisons of amounts but not iffs: put as border. No mark holds 'fixes' (one kind's share reaches the whole as the other ends). The potential has no role. Left out by the limit of six: sampled_count, varied_vanishes, neutral_share, favoured_share_above, fixationBy, Flow.ended_falls_back. The dynamic lists no witness; the three built cases are the module's own.

cards.plain_en: In one model of a rule of entry, a rule taught only by its holders never returns once no holder is left, and nothing returns from an emptied stock.
cards.plain_zh: 在一个准入规则的模型里：只由持者传授的规则，持者一尽便不复生；存量一旦取空，也不再回来。

cast.as: the rule of entry: a quota in common and a door kept by its teachers
the rule as held: at least one holder stands
the holders, by cohort, each staying a tenure of s steps; the teachers are the holders of at least the teaching age
the entrants of each step: those entering as holders, at the quota, and the others, who come untaught past the door
the level the members draw on, in whole units
all members, holders and others alike, one unit each a step (the take)
a constant renewal g at each step that does not end

ties.as: the rule is held on through new cohorts of holders as old cohorts leave after a tenure
taught by members (a cohort enters holding only where holders of at least the teaching age stand), from outside, or not at all; a revision of the quota takes only where a holder stands
the door: holders enter at the quota where any teacher stands; each teacher turns away c of those who would come untaught
each member draws one unit a step; where the level is nothing, or the take exceeds the level and the renewal, the level goes to nothing and all members leave
the level gains the renewal g at each step that does not end; nothing renews from empty
whether a difference in the quota reaches the later levels and members; with no holder the quota is read by nothing

laws.sameness: held or not (at least one holder, or none)
laws.then_en: No holder at the next step, whatever is chosen: on every course from there the rule is not held again, for good.
laws.then_zh: 不论所择为何，下一步仍无持者：此后在每条进程上，规则不再有持者，永远如此。
laws.evidence: theorem «无持者不复» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .members ∨ r.source = .none) : «闭» (net r) NoHolder  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean; net r x y := ∃ m, y = step r m x; with «无持者改不行»: (step r m x).quota = x.quota where no holder stands]

laws.sameness: at the end (level zero, no member) or not
laws.then_en: The next step is again level zero with no member, whatever is chosen: nothing begins again, on every course, for good.
laws.then_zh: 不论所择为何，下一步仍是储为零而无成员：在每条进程上，永不复生。
laws.evidence: theorem «尽而不复» (r : Rule) : «闭» (net r) Gone  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean; Gone x := x.level = 0 ∧ sumL x.holders = 0 ∧ sumL x.others = 0; at every source; the model's clause that nothing renews from empty]

laws.sameness: level, holders and others by cohort, the quota left out
laws.then_en: At every later step the two have the same level, holders and others, along every course of choices: the quota reaches none of them.
laws.then_zh: 此后每一步，沿每条进程，二者的储、持者、其余皆同：额不及其中任何一项。
laws.evidence: (hl : x.level = y.level) (hh : x.holders = y.holders) (ho : x.others = y.others) (hx : NoHolder x) : ∀ k, (run r c k x).level = (run r c k y).level ∧ (run r c k x).holders = (run r c k y).holders ∧ (run r c k x).others = (run r c k y).others  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean]

laws.sameness: held or not (at least one holder, or none)
laws.then_en: Taught from outside, holders begin at the next step; taught by members or not at all, there is none at the next step.
laws.then_zh: 由外传授，下一步即有持者；由成员传授或无所传授，下一步无持者。
laws.evidence: theorem «三源之表» {r : Rule} (hsp : 1 ≤ r.tenure) {x : St} (hq : 1 ≤ x.quota) (hL : 1 ≤ x.level) (h0 : sumL x.holders = 0) (o0 : sumL x.others = 0) (rev : Option Nat) : (r.source = .outside → Held (step r ⟨true, rev⟩ x)) ∧ (r.source = .members → ¬ Held (step r ⟨true, rev⟩ x)) ∧ (r.source = .none → ¬ Held (step r ⟨true, rev⟩ x))  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean; the atlas lists no takes for this law under any dynamic, so main_ifs is empty; its hypotheses match the ledger's rulerebuilding-taught-from-outside, rulerebuilding-noholder, rulerebuilding-quota-at-least-one and rulerebuilding-level-at-least-one, with no other member and a tenure of at least one; the exit drops rulerebuilding-taught-within]

laws.sameness: held or not (at least one holder, or none)
laws.then_en: From the tenure's step on there is no holder, on every course, entrants on offer or not, from every level, for good.
laws.then_zh: 自任满之步起无持者，在每条进程上、不论有无来者、不论储之多少，永远如此。
laws.compare_en: the tenure against the teaching age (tenure at most the teaching age: no holder reaches the age at which it teaches)
laws.evidence: theorem «不及任则持尽» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .members) (hsl : r.tenure ≤ r.teachingAge) (c : Nat → Move) {x : St} (hlen : x.holders.length ≤ r.tenure) : ∀ k, r.tenure ≤ k → sumL (run r c k x).holders = 0  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean; twin «额零则持尽»: the same end at a quota of nothing with no revision to a nonzero one]

laws.sameness: a level above nothing, or the end (level zero, no member)
laws.then_en: At some step the course reaches the end, level zero with no member; until then it stays in the family.
laws.then_zh: 到某一步，进程至于尽：储为零而无成员；在此之前，步步仍在该族状态之内。
laws.compare_en: the constant take against the renewal (the take is the renewal plus d, d at least one)
laws.evidence: theorem «恒取逾生则尽» {r : Rule} {c : Nat → Move} {F : St → Prop} {d : Nat} (hc : Closed r c F) (ht : ∀ y, F y → take y = r.renewal + d) (hd : 1 ≤ d) {x : St} (hx : F x) : ∃ k, Gone (run r c (k + 1) x) ∧ ∀ i, i ≤ k → F (run r c i x)  [Becoming/RuleRebuilding.lean; with «恒取逾生则减» (the level falls by d a step) and «恒取不逾生则存» (a take within the renewal: the level does not fall)]

built_cases.shows_en: Held at the start, tenure equal to the teaching age: no holder is left after two steps.

cards.misfit: One thing fills several roles: the rule is both what entry goes by (rule) and what goes on through cohorts of holders (pattern); a holder is at once a part of the rule as held, one of the selected and a drawer, since the model merges being taught, keeping the door and membership into one count. Where the rule is taught from (members, outside, nowhere) is a parameter of the set-from tie; exit 1 compares three rules of one family from the same state, which is put as two-courses though it is not two courses of one rule, and the atlas gives that theorem no takes. The theorems hold over the whole net (every choice of entrants on offer and of revision at every step): 'on every course of this net' is written in the extent, and the frames do not separate it from one course. The family in 恒取逾生则尽 is a family of states, not of conditions. That nothing renews from empty is the model's own clause, not a theorem. The dynamic lists no witness; the one built case is the module's own.

cards.plain_en: What tops up a stock and is rebuilt from it outlasts any supply cut if the stock is large enough; where it ends the stock is empty, and neither returns.
cards.plain_zh: 一个给存量补给、又靠这份存量重建自身的东西，断供再长，只要存量够多就撑得过；它亡时存量已空，两者都不再回来。

cast.as: the reader: a list of units by age, present while it has a unit
the reader's units, each ageing to the span and then ending, at most one rebuilt a step
the level, in whole units, the model's stock (储)
the step's draw of one unit, and the rebuild, which takes one unit of the level for a new unit
the supply, on or off at each step, read into the level by the units up to the set level; a cut is steps with it off
the reader rebuilt from the level: its rebuild needs a unit of the level

ties.as: the reader goes on while its units age out and are rebuilt (present after a step, after a run)
the rebuild draws one unit of the level it reads; each step also draws one
while the supply is on, the units read it into the level, up to the set level
the rebuild needs a unit of the level; under a cut a step takes at most two units, so the stock buys time

laws.sameness: level empty or not
laws.then_en: Where the reader is gone after a step, the level after that step is empty, the supply on or off.
laws.then_zh: 读者在某一步后已亡，则那一步后存量为零，不论供给通断。
laws.evidence: theorem «读者绝则无储» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .level) (hn : 1 ≤ r.count) (on : Bool) (x : St) (gone : (step r on x).ages = []) : (step r on x).level = 0 — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean

laws.sameness: present or not (has a unit), with the level empty or not
laws.then_en: With the reader gone and the level empty, every step, supply on or off, leaves both so: neither returns on any course.
laws.then_zh: 读者已亡、存量已空，则不论供给通断，每一步之后仍是如此：哪条进程上都不复生。
laws.evidence: theorem «取于储者绝而不复» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .level) : «闭» (net r) (fun x => x = ⟨0, []⟩) — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean

laws.lean: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»
laws.sameness: present or not after a number of cut steps, by the starting level
laws.then_en: Under a cut the stock buys the reader time, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level.
laws.then_zh: 断供之下存量为读者换来时间、存量空则读者亡，恰在重建取自存量之时。
laws.evidence: theorem «以储买时当且仅当取于储» {r : Rule} (hn : 1 ≤ r.count) (hspan : 1 ≤ r.span) : BuysTime r ↔ r.source = .level — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean (BuysTime r := (∀ k, ∃ l, Present (run r false (k + 1) (fresh r.count l))) ∧ ∃ k, (run r false k (fresh r.count 0)).ages = [])

laws.sameness: present or not (has a unit)
laws.then_en: Where the rebuild draws on the supply instead, a reader that is gone begins again at the next supplied step, from every level.
laws.then_zh: 若重建改取自供给，已亡的读者在下一个有供给的步之后复生，不论存量多少。
laws.evidence: theorem «取于供者复» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .supply) (hn : 1 ≤ r.count) (l : Nat) : Present (step r true ⟨l, []⟩) — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean

laws.sameness: present or not after the cut steps
laws.then_en: Under a cut, from a level of at least twice the number of steps, the reader is present after those steps.
laws.then_zh: 断供之下，起始存量不少于步数的两倍，这些步之后读者仍在。
laws.compare_en: the level at the start of the cut, against twice the number of cut steps (a lower bound: a cut step takes at most two units)
laws.evidence: theorem «断而有储则读者存» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .level) (hn : 1 ≤ r.count) : ∀ (k : Nat) (x : St), 2 * (k + 1) ≤ x.level → Present (run r false (k + 1) x) — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean

laws.sameness: present or not (has a unit)
laws.then_en: Under a cut, a reader of new units rebuilt from the supply is gone after its span of steps, from every level.
laws.then_zh: 断供之下，由供给重建、单元全新的读者，过了寿期那么多步即亡，不论存量多少。
laws.evidence: theorem «断则取于供者尽» {r : Rule} (hs : r.source = .supply) (hspan : 1 ≤ r.span) (l : Nat) : (run r false r.span (fresh r.count l)).ages = [] — Becoming/ReaderRebuilding.lean

built_cases.shows_en: One unit of span two: each three further units of stock buy two more cut steps, for levels below 15.
One unit, span three, rebuilt from the supply: ends at step three of a cut from every level below 16.

cards.misfit: The model's reader reads a level (its units lift it toward a set level from the supply): that is neither web.json's readers, through which a rule is read, nor a reading of something, so it is cast as a pattern that also draws on and depends on its stock. The family-H card on the same Lean (the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it) casts it as readers, so the same theorems sit at two places with a seam between. The model's Rule (span, count, set level, source) is the step's own law, not a rule that selects. The reader goes on through units that age out and are rebuilt, put here at passes-on; the Lean file says the turnover read as the account's carrying is not modelled. The family theorem is an iff between the rebuild's source and a joint statement (lasts from enough stock, ends from none), not a comparison of amounts: typed a tie holding both ways (lasts, exact), and its frame needs courses from several starting levels. «取于储者绝而不复» starts from the ended state and says it stays so on every branch: marked absent; with «读者绝则无储» it is what makes the end for good. «断则取于供者尽» takes another member of the family (rebuilt from the supply) and is marked by_outside, though the atlas files it under a transition, not an exit. The atlas files «取于供者复»'s premises under the family-H dynamic, not this one. Left out by the limit of six: «供则读者不绝» (present after a supplied step from every level) and «不复建者尽» (never rebuilt: gone after its span, supplied or not).

cards.plain_en: In any process where only gated moves can change something, it stays the same along every course without them, and every change or first appearance passes through a gated move.
cards.plain_zh: 任何过程中，若只有经门的动作能改变某样东西，那么不经门的进程都保持它，它的每次改变或初现必经一道门。

cast.as: any process with moves, a gate (a decided mark on moves) and a quantity or a property of its configurations
cast.lean: Process S A; gate : A → Bool; q : S → R; p : S → Prop (Becoming.Gated.KeptBy, PreservedBy, ReflectedBy)

cast.as: the rule in force in one declared finite protocol (majority, or two votes after a wait), which only an adoption changes
cast.lean: Becoming.RuleHandoff.State.rule; rule_kept : Gated.KeptBy process adopts State.rule

cast.as: the pool: a chosen set of species in a model of recipes and reactions, present while the inventory holds a member

laws.sameness: the quantity's value at the course's two ends
laws.then_en: A quantity keeps its value along every course of ungated moves exactly where every ungated step keeps it.
laws.then_zh: 一个量沿每条不经门的进程保持不变，恰在每个不经门的步都保持它之时。
laws.evidence: theorem kept_along_iff : (∀ s plan t, Trace P s plan t → (∀ a, a ∈ plan → gate a = false) → q t = q s) ↔ KeptBy P gate q — Becoming/Gated.lean

laws.sameness: the property holds or fails
laws.then_en: A course from where the property holds to where it fails contains a gated move.
laws.then_zh: 从性质成立处走到不成立处的进程，其中必有一个经门的动作。
laws.evidence: theorem leaving_passes_gate (preserved : PreservedBy P gate p) : ∀ {s t : S} {plan : List A}, Trace P s plan t → p s → ¬ p t → ∃ a, a ∈ plan ∧ gate a = true — Becoming/Gated.lean

laws.sameness: the property holds or not
laws.then_en: A course ending where the property holds started where it held, or has a gated step right after which it holds.
laws.then_zh: 终点处性质成立的进程，或起点已成立，或其中有一个经门的步，此步之后性质成立。
laws.evidence: theorem origin (reflected : ReflectedBy P gate p) : ∀ {s t} {plan}, Trace P s plan t → p t → p s ∨ ∃ pre a post m m', plan = pre ++ a :: post ∧ Trace P s pre m ∧ P.step m a m' ∧ gate a = true ∧ p m' ∧ Trace P m' post t — Becoming/Gated.lean

laws.sameness: the quantity's value

cards.misfit: Mixed. The four Gated theorems hold of every process and name no role (a gate, a quantity and a property are not among the kinds): they are legend, written here under 'any'. The two instances name roles, the rule in force in one declared protocol where only adoption is gated, and a pool of species in a model of recipes; through them alone the dynamic meets the web, at the roles rule and pattern and at no tie, so the card is not marked legend. They are instances the mechanism states, not theorems its exits cite. The pool is cast as a pattern, though it is read as amounts in an inventory and could as well be a stock. cards.plain_en: Where groups with less of something leave no offspring, selection among groups never goes against it; groups all depending on one overdrawn stock end together, none selected.

laws.sameness: a group leaves offspring or none

laws.sameness: the mean of the amount across one step of descent
laws.then_en: Across the step the mean of the amount among the members rises.
laws.then_zh: 跨过这一步，成员中这个量的均值上升。

built_cases.shows_en: The other group ended, a groupmate leaves five and the member holding back one: the whole selects against holding back.
A patch renewed from a neighbour shows no excess alone; read as one family, both formations end from step three.

cards.misfit: Concordance and discordance (how far more offspring go with more, or with less, of an amount, summed over ordered pairs) are counts the kinds hold only as 'selects'; the division into a part within groups and a part among groups is two levels of one selects tie, which a single tie cannot show. coupled_end_together concludes two things at once (each group leaves no offspring; nothing is selected among the groups) and is filed under the first. raises_of_inactive concludes a strict comparison of means across one step from conditions that are not amounts: filed as a border of sufficient strength, not a threshold. Which condition runs into excess, and that members depend on their own group's condition, are hypotheses wherever they enter.

cards.plain_en: Where each step takes at least one unit from a stock that must stay above a floor, a stock too short for the steps ahead fails on every course.
cards.plain_zh: 每一步都至少取走一单位、而存量又须守在底线之上时，存量撑不够所需的步数，走哪条进程都守不住。

cast.as: any law of change with admissible disturbances, a guard and a family of levels its steps drain
cast.lean: f : S → A → S, adm, guard; Becoming.Lasting.Drains, Lasting.Ladder, Lasting.Lasts

cast.as: the market model's support stock, with its essential floor 5
the guarded run of the market model, going on only while the stock is at or above the floor
the operating step's depreciation and damage with the support shocks: at least one unit a step while the share is at most 1/6
the renewing share (the seed), in [0, 1], giving to the stock in proportion and growing by at most 3/2 a step; nothing injected

ties.as: the guard: the guarded run stops once the stock is below the floor 5; the margin is the stock above 5
while the share is at most 1/6 and shocks are nonnegative, each step leaves the stock at least one unit lower
the renewing share gives to the stock in proportion; a seed with share times (3/2)^N at most 1/6 stays too small for N steps

laws.sameness: within the guard or not
laws.then_en: No admissible history from that start stays within the guard at every step through n.

laws.sameness: stock at or above the floor: the guarded run going or stopped
laws.then_en: The guarded run ends by step N, on every schedule of β and every sequence of nonnegative shocks.

laws.sameness: stock at or above the floor: the guarded run going or stopped

laws.sameness: stock at or above the floor: the guarded run going or stopped

laws.then_zh: 到第 N 步仍在的设限进程，起始存量不低于底线 5 加 N。
laws.compare_en: the starting stock, against the floor 5 plus the number of steps N (for a seed whose share times (3/2)^N is at most 1/6)

built_cases.shows_en: A drained family holds a start at level 1, yet the start does not last one step.
With no shock, every stock of at least 5 carries the state of share 1, quality 1 at every step.
One positive state lands in protection once its stock is left out, while its full guarded run stops.

cards.misfit: The two core theorems (Drains.leaves, lasts_iff_ladder) are of every law of change with disturbances and a guard and name no role: they belong to the legend and carry the role 'any'; the card is placed on the web by its market instance only. A drained family of levels is any family of predicates, not a stock: reading it as a stock above a floor is the instance's, not the theorem's. The market's guard (the run stopping once the stock is below the floor 5) is held as a need; the bound on the share's growth, the schedule of β and the quality error have no kind. finite_support_forces_failure and support_required_for_small_prefix are one comparison said two ways (short stock ends the run; a run still going shows the stock); the atlas gives the transition no strength, and 'necessary' is from the statement. The obstruction is conservative, not an exact border, so both are borders of one-sided strength.

cards.plain_en: A reading, with none proved, names four routes out of a region that keeps a course: a parameter change, a shock, failed correction, or change too fast for correction.
cards.plain_zh: 这是一则解读，四条都未证明：进程离开一个留得住它的区域有四条路——参数改变、冲击、纠正失灵、变化快过纠正。

cast.as: a course kept within a region of the market model (the protected region; the degenerate one); the reading's word is a region's retention
correction: what restores the level against erosion, where it is paid and in time (the reading's word)
the level that correction keeps above its floor, and the support a selection can erode (the reading's words)
a selection that absorbs perturbations (the reading's word: attraction)

ties.as: a reading: correction restores the level; routes three and four are a failure stopping it and change too fast for it
a reading: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support (attraction is not continuation)

cards.misfit: An AI reading (D65) of the market model's boundary and attraction results, with no Lean declaration and no record: there is no theorem to write up, and none of the four routes is a proved transition. The cast and the two ties are the reading's own words about the market model, not a theorem's roles. Routes one and two (a parameter change removing a region's retention; a shock into another retained region) are about staying in a region or leaving it, which the kinds hold only as the legend; a parameter and a shock have no role kind. The reading's further remarks (a negative margin gives a degenerate region, not entry into it; a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share theorem lacks; a real loss need not form a meta-attractor) are in the proved dynamic market-model-share-margin-and-ends or are readings too.

cards.plain_en: A stock nearing the end of its own renewal recovers more slowly, so its fluctuations grow and show how near that end is, but not how near a dependent's need.
cards.plain_zh: 存量临近自身更新的尽头时回复变慢，涨落变大，从中读得出离尽头多远，却读不出离依者所需多远。

cast.as: the observed condition: its level about a rest, the deviation Y stepping by the return multiplier a plus independent noise E
the stock's own renewal: the fold step x + h(m − x²) with margin m; logistic renewal at rate r with capacity K
a proportional draw q against the logistic renewal
a dependent with a need n; the need is no argument of the stock's law
the stationary statistics of the fluctuations: variance and lag-1 autocorrelation; any reading R of the multiplier
the return multiplier a, and through it the margin to the stock's own end (m at a fold; r − q under a draw) and the level at rest

ties.as: the margin to the stock's own end couples into its fluctuations: it sets the return multiplier, which sets the variance and the lag-1 autocorrelation
the lag-1 autocorrelation is the multiplier, and the margin to the fold and the level at the drawn rest are read from it exactly
a proportional draw q on a stock renewing at rate r: the multiplier is 1 − h(r − q)
renewal returns a deviation toward the rest, by the multiplier a at each step (a = 1 − 2h√m at a fold)
a need n and the margin x − n from the stock's level to it
the dependent's need enters neither statistic: it lies beyond the reading, by construction

laws.sameness: the fluctuations' variance
laws.then_en: At a step that keeps the deviation's variance, that variance equals the noise variance over one minus the multiplier squared.
laws.then_zh: 方差跨步不变之处，偏离的方差等于噪声方差除以一减回复乘数的平方。
laws.compare_en: the deviation's variance with the noise variance divided by one minus the squared return multiplier: equal
laws.evidence: (ha : a ^ 2 < 1) (hs : Var[step a Y E; μ] = Var[Y; μ]) : Var[Y; μ] = stationaryVariance a Var[E; μ] — lean/warning/SlowingDown.lean

laws.sameness: the lag-1 autocorrelation
laws.then_en: At a step that keeps a positive variance, the lag-1 autocorrelation of the deviation equals the return multiplier.
laws.then_zh: 方差跨步不变且为正之处，偏离的一阶自相关等于回复乘数。
laws.compare_en: the lag-1 autocorrelation of the deviation with the return multiplier: equal
laws.evidence: (hs : Var[step a Y E; μ] = Var[Y; μ]) (hv : 0 < Var[Y; μ]) : lag1 Y (step a Y E) μ = a — lean/warning/SlowingDown.lean

laws.sameness: how near one the return multiplier is
laws.then_en: At a fold the return multiplier tends to one from below as the margin to the stock's own end shrinks to nothing.
laws.then_zh: 在折叠处，离存量自身尽头的余裕缩向零时，回复乘数自下趋于一。
laws.evidence: (hh : 0 < h) : Tendsto (foldMultiplier h) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[<] 1) — lean/warning/SlowingDown.lean

laws.sameness: how near one the return multiplier is
laws.then_en: Under a proportional draw the return multiplier tends to one from below as the draw rises to the renewal rate.
laws.then_zh: 按比例取用时，所取升向更新之率，回复乘数自下趋于一。
laws.evidence: (hh : 0 < h) (r : ℝ) : Tendsto (drawnMultiplier h r) (𝓝[<] r) (𝓝[<] 1) — lean/warning/SlowingDown.lean

laws.sameness: the margin to the fold
laws.then_en: The margin to the fold is read exactly from the return multiplier a: m = ((1 − a)/(2h))².
laws.then_zh: 离折叠的余裕可从回复乘数 a 恰好读出：m = ((1 − a)/(2h))²。
