laws.then_en: The whole is active at every step from T + d on.
laws.then_zh: 从第 T + d 步起，整体每一步都活跃。
laws.compare_en: how long a part stays active after it begins (d steps) against the longest gap between parts beginning (one within every d steps)
laws.evidence: theorem Whole.persists_from {d T : Nat} (whole : W.Whole parts w) (arising : ∀ S, T ≤ S → ∃ j p, j < d ∧ parts p ∧ W.Arises (S + j) p) (lasts : ∀ t p, parts p → W.Arises t p → ∀ i, i < d → W.active (t + 1 + i) p) : ∀ t, T + d ≤ t → W.active t w  (Becoming/Wholes.lean:272)

built_cases.shows_en: A whole of one always-active part stays active at every step while nothing ever begins.
With infinitely many parts active at once, each ending, the whole stays active and nothing begins; no list names them.
Parts each active at one odd step begin arbitrarily late, yet the whole is inactive at every even step.

cards.misfit: Being a whole is coincidence of activity, not constitution: every formation is the whole of itself, and two always-active formations are each the whole of the other, so which role is the pattern and which the parts is supplied by the case, not shown by a theorem. Which formations are parts is fixed for every step. arises_within and needs_new conclude a negated 'for all': they name no part and no step, and no form says 'not refutably'; written 'cannot'. Under brevity the parts that begin may be the same parts beginning again; only with ending, listed parts are they ever new. The theorems say nothing of the parts' or the whole's stocks, needs or drawing.

cards.plain_en: A pattern outlasting each carrier lasts only while carriers keep beginning; where carrying comes only by passing, it keeps being passed, and ends within a carrier's span once passing stops.
cards.plain_zh: 比每个承载者都长久的样式，只有承载者不断开始承载才能持续；承载如果只能靠传递得来，样式就得一传再传，传递一停，过不了一个承载者的时长就亡。

cast.as: a pattern carried in a web; present at a step where some formation carries it
its carriers: the formations carrying it, brief for d (none carries at two steps d apart); a carrier begins across a step

ties.as: a carrier passes the pattern to a carrier across a step (Web.PassesAt; the Lean reads passes t b a as 'b gives the pattern to a'); the passing premise (Web.ByPassing): whatever carries it after a step carried it before or was passed it across the step by a carrier

laws.sameness: carrying the pattern or not
laws.then_en: From every step S from T on, it cannot be that no carrier begins across any of the d steps from S.
laws.then_zh: 从 T 起任取一步 S：S 起的 d 步里，不会没有承载者开始承载。
laws.compare_en: the number of consecutive steps with no carrier beginning, against d, the span no carrier carries across
laws.evidence: theorem begins_within {d T : Nat} (present : ∀ t, T ≤ t → V.Present t) (brief : ∀ a, V.Brief d a) {S : Nat} (after : T ≤ S) : ¬ ∀ j, j < d → ∀ a, ¬ V.Arises (S + j) a  (Becoming/PatternPassing.lean:117)

laws.sameness: present or not (some carrier carries it)
laws.then_en: Across one of every d consecutive steps from T on, a carrier passes the pattern to a carrier.
laws.then_zh: 从 T 起每连续 d 步里，总有一步上有承载者把样式传给承载者。
laws.compare_en: the number of consecutive steps with no passing, against d, the span no carrier carries across
laws.evidence: theorem ByPassing.passes_within (by_passing : V.ByPassing passes) {d T : Nat} (present : ∀ t, T ≤ t → V.Present t) (brief : ∀ a, V.Brief d a) {S : Nat} (after : T ≤ S) : ∃ j, j < d ∧ V.PassesAt passes (S + j)  (Becoming/PatternPassing.lean:475)

laws.sameness: present or not (some carrier carries it)
laws.then_en: No carrier carries the pattern at any later step: once absent at a step, it does not begin again.
laws.then_zh: 此后每一步都没有承载者：有一步没有承载者，样式就不再生。
laws.evidence: theorem ByPassing.empty_stays (by_passing : V.ByPassing passes) {t : Nat} (empty : ¬ V.Present t) {t' : Nat} (later : t ≤ t') : ¬ V.Present t'  (Becoming/PatternPassing.lean:169)

laws.sameness: present or not (some carrier carries it)
laws.then_en: No carrier carries the pattern at any step from T + d on: it ends for good, within d steps of the stop.
laws.then_zh: 从第 T + d 步起每一步都没有承载者：传停之后 d 步以内样式亡，此后不再有。
laws.compare_en: the steps since passing stopped, against d, the span no carrier carries across
laws.evidence: theorem ByPassing.ends_within (by_passing : V.ByPassing passes) {d T : Nat} (brief : ∀ a, V.Brief d a) (stopped : ∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬ V.PassesAt passes t) {t : Nat} (later : T + d ≤ t) : ¬ V.Present t  (Becoming/PatternPassing.lean:519)

laws.sameness: the pattern's class (alike in carrying the pattern or not)
laws.then_en: The passing premise holds exactly where every occurrence carrying the pattern after a step has a predecessor (有前) under the pattern's class.
laws.then_zh: 传递前提成立，恰好在这样的地方：一步之后每个承载样式的发生，在样式的类下都有前。
laws.evidence: theorem byPassing_iff_hasPred : V.ByPassing passes ↔ ∀ t a, V.active (t + 1) a → «有前» (continuationStep (passingContinuation passes)) V.activityClass (t + 1, a)  (Becoming/PatternPassing.lean:365)

built_cases.shows_en: Carriers each carrying two steps pass the pattern to the next: each carrier ends, the pattern is present throughout.
With passing stopped from step T, the pattern is present up to step T+1 and at no step from T+2.
Carriers in shifts of two steps: beginning and passing happen across odd steps only, so the bound d is attained.

cards.misfit: The passing premise is a supplied reading of how carrying forms (a hypothesis), and the passing relation is supplied too: PassesAt also counts a formation passing the pattern to itself, so a passing is not always a turnover of carriers, which the tie's 'passes on or keeps' split does not show. begins_within concludes a negated 'for all' and names no carrier; written 'cannot'. byPassing_iff_hasPred restates one premise in the grammar's words (有前 under the pattern's class); 'same-as' is the nearest form, though it joins a premise to the grammar, not two models' laws. empty_stays uses only that a carrier after a step has a carrier before it, whatever the passing relation is. ends_within does not say the pattern was present before T + d; 'ends' is the nearest mark. Whether a pattern changes as it is passed is not said, so no 'changes' statement of the pattern stands here.

cards.plain_en: A level corrected from both sides, never past its target, settles there; a rule reading it late can keep it only within a band that grows with the delay.
cards.plain_zh: 两边都往回拉、又不拉过头，水平就定在目标上；读得迟的规则只能把它守在一条带里，读得越迟，带越宽。

cast.as: a condition's level, read against a mark m or a band [a, b]
the formations taking part, in all they take from the condition; the rest's taking
the formations taking part, in all they give to the condition; the rest's giving
a rule of regulation: from the rest's record, what the regulator gives and takes at each step; the relay with band [a, b] and step M, giving M below a and taking M above b

ties.as: all that is taken from the condition across a step (L.taken t c)
all that is given to it across a step (L.given t c), and how giving against taking answers the level: opposing its departure from m (Flow.Opposes), within its gap to m (Flow.WithinGap)
what the rule reads reaches it ℓ steps late: the rest's exchanges, which show in the level ℓ steps before (Regulation.ReadsLate ℓ ρ); for the relay, the level itself ℓ steps before (Flow.RelaysLate)

laws.sameness: exchange within the gap to m, or beyond it
laws.then_en: The joint exchange is within the level's gap to m exactly where the next level lies between m and the present level.
laws.then_zh: 取给之差不超过水平到 m 的距离，恰在下一步的水平落在 m 与现水平之间之时。
laws.compare_en: how far what is taken and what is given differ, on each side, against the level's gap to m; equivalently the next level against m and the present level
laws.evidence: L.WithinGap W m t c ↔ Between m (W.level t c) (W.level (t + 1) c) — Regulation.lean:269

laws.sameness: level at m or not
laws.then_en: From step T plus the level's gap to m at T on, the level is m at every step: it lasts at rest.
laws.then_zh: 从 T 加上那时水平到 m 的距离的那一步起，水平步步是 m：住而不动。
laws.evidence: (within : ∀ k, L.WithinGap W m (T + k) c) (opposes : ∀ k, L.Opposes W m (T + k) c) (late : T + gap (W.level T c) m ≤ t) : W.level t c = m — Regulation.lean:375

laws.sameness: the same stock's level (finer: its side of m)
laws.then_en: At the next step the level, above m before, is below m: it goes on as a level and differs in side.
laws.then_zh: 下一步，原在 m 之上的水平到了 m 之下：水平仍延，所在的一边异。
laws.evidence: (opposes : L.Opposes W m t c) (above : m < W.level t c) (beyond : ¬ L.WithinGap W m t c) : W.level (t + 1) c < m — Regulation.lean:423

laws.sameness: level below m or not
laws.then_en: From that step on the level is below m at every step: below m lasts, and it does not return to m.
laws.then_zh: 从这一步起，水平步步在 m 之下：住于 m 之下，不回到 m。
laws.evidence: (noRaise : ∀ t, T ≤ t → W.level t c < m → L.given t c ≤ L.taken t c) (below : W.level T c < m) (n : Nat) : W.level (T + n) c < m — Continuation.lean:450

laws.sameness: level within the band [a, b] from some step on, or not
laws.then_en: Every run of the relay from a start held below the band stays within it from some step on, exactly where a+(ℓ+1)M ≤ b+1.
laws.then_zh: 迟 ℓ 步读的阈值调节，凡起初停在带下的进程，从某一步起水平都留在带内，恰在 a+(ℓ+1)M ≤ b+1 之时。
laws.compare_en: the band's lower end plus lateness-plus-one times the relay's step, a + (ℓ+1)M, against one past the band's upper end, b + 1
laws.evidence: (∀ x₀, x₀ < a → ∀ … L'.RelaysLate W' c' ℓ a b M → (∀ t, L'.BalancesOn W' [c'] t) → (∀ i, i ≤ ℓ → W'.level i c' = x₀) → ∃ T, ∀ j, a ≤ W'.level (T + j) c' ∧ W'.level (T + j) c' ≤ b) ↔ a + (ℓ + 1) * M ≤ b + 1 — Regulation.lean:1989

laws.sameness: level within the band [a, b] at every step, or not
laws.then_en: No rule reading ℓ steps late keeps the level at every step, under every rest within d, in a band narrower than 2(ℓ+1)d.
laws.then_zh: 迟 ℓ 步读的规则，无一能在其余每步至多推动 d 的一切情形下，步步把水平留在窄于 2(ℓ+1)d 的带内。
laws.compare_en: the band's width, b − a, against twice lateness-plus-one times the most the rest moves the level in a step, 2(ℓ+1)d
laws.evidence: (late : ReadsLate ℓ ρ) (x₀ : Nat) (pos : 0 < a) (keeps : ∀ δ, NetWithin d δ → ∀ t, a ≤ course ρ δ x₀ t ∧ course ρ δ x₀ t ≤ b) : a + (ℓ + 1) * (d + d) ≤ b — Regulation.lean:886

built_cases.shows_en: Opposed from both sides beyond the gap, a level is above m at even steps and below it at odd.
With nothing exchanged, the one-sided premise and the bound hold, and the level stays above m at every step.
The late return, reading ℓ steps late, keeps the level within (ℓ+1)d of any start with that much room.

cards.misfit: Left out by the six-theorem cap: exit 4 (Regulation.held_oscillates: past b + 2 ≤ a + (ℓ+1)M the level from a start held at a − 1 leaves both ends of the band without end) and Flow.stock_settles (a family of stocks each so regulated settles in total, nothing reading the total). The rule here answers a level by giving and taking; it selects among nothing, so the rule role stands without a selects tie. The mark m and the band [a, b] are amounts read on the stock, not a need: no dependent is named. The two late-reading theorems are filed on the stock (the band its level is kept in); the lateness of the reaches tie is their premise and enters the amount compared. no_narrower_band's Lean is one-way (keeping the band gives a + 2(ℓ+1)d ≤ b, with 0 < a), said here as cannot; its premise ranges over every rest within d (a family of courses of one rule), which no frame names; two-courses is the shape of its proof. relay_threshold's iff ranges over every run of the relay; past the threshold it speaks only of the run from a − 1. The atlas files transition 2 as an exact threshold; the Lean has two one-way theorems (no_narrower_band necessary; lateReturn_band attains it from starts with room).

cards.plain_en: In one built example, read by kind, new lines keep opening while each kind renews through short-lived members; read member by member, the same course only repeats every two steps.
cards.plain_zh: 同一条造出的进程，按类来读，新的线不断生出，每一类靠短命的成员相传；按名来读，它只是每两步重复一次。

cast.as: a line of supported occurrences along a reading: within a kind, by name, or the whole lineage along passing of support
six formations of two kinds (a0, a1, e; b0, b1, c), each supported for one step at a time
each formation, requiring its own condition at need one: supported where that condition holds a unit
each formation's own condition, holding units by the step's parity; in the fed relay also a condition of fuel for each step
the supported formation that moves its units to another formation's condition

ties.as: a line goes on through formations each supported one step, support passing from one to the next (Flow.PassesSupport; «传»)
a supported formation takes all its own condition holds and moves the units to other formations' conditions, within and across kinds, with period two
a formation is supported at a step where its own condition holds its need of one; none is supported at two steps running (Runs.supported; holds_brief)

laws.sameness: linked within a kind: carrying on while supported, or passing within a kind
laws.then_en: In one built case, read within kinds, from step 0 on every supported line lasts and after every step a new line begins.
laws.then_zh: 在一个造出的例子里，按类内相传来读：从第 0 步起，受支撑的线条条都住，每一步之后都有新线生。
laws.evidence: theorem keeps_widening : web.KeepsWidening (web.withinKind sameKind (flow.PassesSupport web)) web.level 0 — KeepingWidening.lean:2486

laws.sameness: of one kind (finer: the same formation); active (finer: of one kind)
laws.then_en: In one built case each kind's line and the whole lineage last without end, passing on: ahead of every point a finer line begins.
laws.then_zh: 在一个造出的例子里，每一类的线与整条世系都延而不尽，靠传而住：线上每一点之后，都有更细一层的线生。
laws.evidence: (run : Runs W L) (start : W.Supported x.1 x.2) : «阶全生成» (Web.continuationStep (Web.passingContinuation (L.PassesSupport W))) ((W.admitting W.level).kindGrains sameKind) 0 x ∧ «阶全生成» … 1 x — KeepingWidening.lean:2259

laws.sameness: the same formation by name
laws.then_en: In the same built case, read by name, from no step on does every supported line last while new lines keep beginning.
laws.then_zh: 同一个例子，按名来读：从哪一步起，都不是受支撑的线条条住、新线又不断生。
laws.evidence: theorem not_keepsWidening_byName (T : Nat) : ¬ web.KeepsWidening Web.itself web.level T — KeepingWidening.lean:2510

built_cases.shows_en: The closed relay's levels and flow at step t + 2 are those at t: it returns with period two.
Read with dormant carrying on, a beginning lies after every step, yet nothing keeps opening from any step.
The fed relay, dissipating a unit of fuel per taker each step (Fed.dissipative), keeps widening within kinds.

cards.misfit: The whole dynamic is one built case read under several samenesses: within kinds it keeps widening, by name it only returns. The card holds this only as separate theorems with different sameness fields; that the reading itself is what is varied has no slot. Keeping widening is two statements at once (every line lasts; after every step a new line begins); filed as lasts, growing. Its denial by name is filed as absent: the Lean denies the conjunction from every step and does not say which half fails (the proof shows no line lasts across a step by name). 全生成 at two orders is a nesting of samenesses (formation within kind within activity) written as one 'lasts, passing on'. The fed relay's point (a loss paid by fuel no formation requires, while what is required conserves) needs a stock that nothing depends on beside stocks that are depended on; shown only as a built case.

cards.plain_en: In one built example a rule is raised every other step: what can be reached without changing the rule keeps growing, everything stays reachable, and renewal never ends.
cards.plain_zh: 一个造出的例子里，规则隔一步抬高一次：不动规则所能到的越来越多，全部可能始终都在，更新也不断。

cast.as: the rule n of a configuration (n, x): a move raises it by one, or keeps it and moves the position to any x′ at most n; what is held is the rule the same
the positions a configuration admits (the docstrings' formations): the possible with the rule held, and the whole possible
the course read moment after moment: its renewal under the rule held, going on from even moment to even moment
the lines under the rule the same: each begins where the rule is raised and goes on one step while it is kept
cast.lean: fun i j => Same (course.state i) (course.state j)

ties.as: the course goes on while lines under the rule held turn over: an even moment conditions a beginning whose line reaches an even moment again («生生»; «全生成» at the one over the rule held)

laws.sameness: possible with the rule held, or not
laws.then_en: In one built case nothing possible with the rule held is lost, and after every step more is possible so: it lasts, growing.
laws.then_zh: 在一个造出的例子里，守着规则所能到的，一样不失，每一步之后还更多：住而长。
laws.evidence: theorem held_keeps_widening : Reaching.KeepsWidening (fun k => Reaching.PossibleHeld process Same adm (course.state k)) — HeldPossible.lean:772

laws.sameness: possible at all, the rule free to change, or not
laws.then_en: In the same built case every position is possible from every configuration of the course: the whole possible is the same at every step.
laws.then_zh: 同一个例子里，从进程的每个构型出发，每个位置都可能：全部可能步步相同。
laws.evidence: theorem whole_every (k y : Nat) : Reaching.Possible process adm (course.state k) y — HeldPossible.lean:779

laws.sameness: the rule the same
laws.then_en: In one built case, after every even moment a line under the rule held begins and reaches the next even moment, without end.
laws.then_zh: 在一个造出的例子里，每个偶数时刻之后，守着规则的一条线生，延到下一个偶数时刻，如此不尽。
laws.evidence: theorem renews_without_end {k : Nat} (even : odd k = false) : «生生» Steps.next (fun i j => Same (course.state i) (course.state j)) k — HeldPossible.lean:785

built_cases.shows_en: On one course the held possible keeps widening and renewal without end holds at moment 0, which does not cease.
With the rule raised at every step, every moment ceases under the rule held, while the held possible keeps widening.
On a tower copying each rule down once, every moment ceases under the rules held from any height up.

cards.misfit: The possible (what could be reached, whole or with a part held) is not a role of the web, which speaks of what goes on; filed under 'what it selects among' as the positions the rule leaves open, with no selects tie, since no theorem here says the rule favours anything. Renewal without end («生生») is read as passing on: the course goes on while lines under the rule held turn over. The Lean's 生生 names one class only (the rule the same) and no coarse line, so the course as 'what goes on' is the map's reading; RaisedEveryOther.generation states the same course as 全生成 at the one over the rule held. 生生 has no mark of its own: written as begins, again and again, each line reaching the next beginning; 息 (ceasing) has none nearer than ends. Every theorem is about one built course; the dynamic's point, that growth relative to what is held and renewal without end are different relations, is a statement about the map's own words more than a place on it. That this 生生 is the ethics' 生生 is no claim of the Lean.

cards.plain_en: When several draw on one stock, their total decides whether what depends on it is cut off; where the total overshoots, drawing less by the excess keeps it supplied.
cards.plain_zh: 多个取用者同取一个存量，依者断不断供，看合起来取了多少；合取过了头，少取超出的那一截，就保得住。

cast.as: a condition's level
the formations taking part, each with its own take, and all that is taken
the formations taking part, in all that is given to the condition
a formation requiring the condition at a need, met at the step

ties.as: the dependence at its need: kept or broken across the step (Web.Kept, Web.Broken); the joint slack is what the level with all given stands above the need
each drawer's own take and all that is taken across the step (L.take t f c, L.taken t c)
all that is given to the condition across the step (L.given t c)

laws.sameness: need met or not
laws.then_en: The dependence breaks across the step, unmet at the next, exactly where its need with all taken exceeds the level with all given.
laws.then_zh: 跨这一步依存断、下一步所需不足，恰在所需加合取之量多于水平加所给之量之时。
laws.compare_en: the need plus all that the drawers take across the step, against the stock's level plus all that is given to it
laws.evidence: W.Broken t g c ↔ W.level t c + L.given t c < W.need t g c + L.taken t c — JointDraw.lean:104

laws.sameness: one drawer's own take against all that is taken
laws.then_en: At that step every drawer taking part takes strictly less than all that is taken.
laws.then_zh: 这一步上，每个取用者所取都少于合取的总量。
laws.evidence: (broken : W.Broken t g c) (within : ∀ f, f ∈ L.present t → L.take t f c + W.need t g c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c) : ∀ f, f ∈ L.present t → L.take t f c < L.taken t c — JointDraw.lean:139

laws.sameness: level at or above the need
laws.then_en: In the course that draws less by the excess, the stock's level at the next step is at least the need.
laws.then_zh: 在少取了超出之量的那条进程里，下一步存量的水平不低于所需。
laws.evidence: (balances' : L'.Balances W') (higher : W.level t c ≤ W'.level t c) (restrained : L'.taken t c + e ≤ L.taken t c) (renewing : L.given t c ≤ L'.given t c) (excess : n + L.taken t c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c + e) : n ≤ W'.level (t + 1) c — JointDraw.lean:150

built_cases.shows_en: Two drawers each take one from a stock at two: the dependent's need of one breaks; it is inactive next.
There each drawer's take is within the joint slack, and each takes less than all that is taken.
With the second drawer taking nothing, the need of one is met before and after the step.

cards.misfit: kept_of_restrained compares two supplied flows that may differ in taking, giving and starting level at once, each in one direction, not in one thing only; two-courses is the nearest frame and order the nearest form (less taken, no less given, a level as high: a next level no lower than n). The atlas reads it as keeping the need met; the statement takes n as any amount the excess covers, names no dependence, and does not say the need was met before the step in the restrained course. broken_shared is an inequality among the drawers' takes read back from a break; filed as shows. Every theorem is of one step of a supplied flow: which drawer takes how much is given to the theorem, so nothing here says a drawer restrains or what would select restraint (the mechanism points to COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 for that edge, whose theorems are filed under other dynamics).

cards.plain_en: Where several draw on one stock by a plan giving each its own separate portion of what comes in, the stock never falls below where it started.
cards.plain_zh: 多个取用者照一个计划取同一存量，各取各的一份、互不重叠、合起来不超过所给，存量就不会低于起初。

cast.as: a condition's level
the formations taking from the condition: what they take is what the plan's leaves draw
what is given to the condition across the step: at least as many units as the list available to the root
a whole realizing a joint plan: the root configuration
the two parts each whole holds, down to the plan's leaves, each with a footprint: the units it draws on
cast.lean: J s l r; footprint; PartsWithin; PartsApart

ties.as: the joint draw: all taken across the step, divided by footprints lying within their whole's and apart from each other
all that is given to the condition across the step, at least as many units as are available to the root

laws.sameness: all taken within all given, or not
laws.then_en: At that step what the drawers take together is at most what is given to the stock.
laws.then_zh: 这一步上，取用者合起来所取，不多于给到存量的。
laws.compare_en: all that is taken from the stock across the step against all that is given to it
laws.evidence: (within : PartsWithin footprint J) (apart : PartsApart footprint J) (realizes : JointPlan.Realizes J (Supports footprint) s p) (root : ∀ a, footprint s a → a ∈ avail) (drawn : L.taken t c = p.draws.length) (given : avail.length ≤ L.given t c) : L.WithinJoint t c — Exclusion.lean:315

laws.sameness: level at or above its start
laws.then_en: At every step the stock's level is at or above its level at the start: it lasts within that bound.
laws.then_zh: 每一步，存量的水平都不低于起初：住在这条界之上。
laws.evidence: (balances : L.Balances W) (within : PartsWithin footprint J) (apart : PartsApart footprint J) (plans : ∀ t, ∃ p s avail, JointPlan.Realizes J (Supports footprint) s p ∧ (∀ a, footprint s a → a ∈ avail) ∧ L.taken t c = p.draws.length ∧ avail.length ≤ L.given t c) : ∀ t, W.level 0 c ≤ W.level t c — Exclusion.lean:327

cards.misfit: A whole holding parts whose footprints lie within its own and apart from each other (J, PartsWithin, PartsApart, JointPlan.Realizes) is a tie between a whole and its parts at one step; the web's pattern-parts tie is going on through parts, so the division is carried only in the cast and in the draws-on tie's words. withinJoint_of_plan concludes a one-way comparison of amounts at one step from a condition on shape. No form holds 'where these hold, one amount is at most another': border is the only form whose conclusion compares amounts, so it is filed there with strength sufficient; it is not an iff, and nothing says the comparison fails where the division does. The plan realized at each step and the footprints as lists of units are supplied, not derived; the theorem does not say the level rises.

cards.plain_en: A gain for each step a stock meets a need keeps every best course meeting it, at any horizon, where it covers the renewal forgone and exceeds the final drain.
cards.plain_zh: 存量每满足所需一步，就多得一份；这一份抵得上每步少得的更新、又多过最后一取，则视野再长，最优的进程也步步满足所需。

cast.as: the one optimizer: what draws along a course of the stock's levels, at most k a step
a condition's level along a course open from the start s (W.level t c)
the renewal law R of the level: at most r at every level, at most q at or above the need
a formation needing m of the condition at every step (W.need t f c = m)
an order over the open courses rising with a worth: the draw, with a coupling c for each step the need stays met

what the course draws across the n + 1 steps of the horizon (drawnOver R x (n + 1))
R gives at each level; keeping the need forgoes r − q of it a step

laws.sameness: need met or not

laws.then_en: Where the order reads every step met, every best open course keeps the stock's level at or above the need through the horizon.

cards.plain_en: A rule taught by the members it limits stays held, from its steady state, exactly where they outlast the teaching age, the quota admits some, and their draw fits renewal.
cards.plain_zh: 规则由受它所限的成员传授：从稳态起它一直有持者，恰在任期长过授业之龄、额不为零、成员所取不超过更新之时。

cast.as: the rule held: at least one holder (Held)
the holders by cohort, youngest first; a cohort leaves at the tenure s
a rule of entry: one quota in common and a door, taught by members, from outside or by nothing (Rule, Source)
the entrants on offer: holders enter at the quota where a teacher stands; of the f others who would come untaught each teacher turns away c
the shared level, in whole units
the members, holders and others alike, one unit each a step (take)
a constant renewal g a step while anything is left; nothing renews from empty

ties.as: each entering cohort is taught by holders of at least the teaching age l and leaves at the tenure s; held, or with no holder (Held, NoHolder)
the take is the count of members; where it exceeds the level with the renewal, all members leave and the level is empty (Ends, Gone)
taught by its members: a cohort enters holding only where holders of the teaching age stand, and a revision of the quota takes only where a holder stands
the door: each teacher turns away c of the f who would come untaught (the leak e q := f − c · q · (s − l)); holders enter at the quota
at each step that does not end the level becomes level + g − take

laws.lean: Becoming.RuleRebuilding.«稳者恒持当且仅当在带»

laws.then_en: From the region, every step with entrants on offer and any revision within [P, Q] leads back into the region.
laws.then_zh: 在域内，凡有来者、改额（若有）不出 [P, Q] 的一步，之后仍在域内。

laws.sameness: held or not: at least one holder
laws.then_en: On every course of choices, from every level, no holder is left at any step from the s-th on.

cards.misfit: One count, the holders, fills three places: the parts that carry the rule, what the rule is set from, and drawers on the stock; the kinds hold these only as separate ties. cards.plain_en: When supply is cut, a stock buys time for what keeps it up, and an empty stock ends it, exactly where its worn parts are rebuilt from that stock.
cards.plain_zh: 断了供，存量能为维持它的读取者买时间，存量一空读取者即亡——恰在读取者的损耗由这存量来重建之时。

cast.as: the rule of the net: a set level m kept while supplied, a set count n of units, and the source a spent unit is rebuilt from (Rule)
the reader: units by age, each ending at the span s; present where at least one unit stands (Present)
the level (储), in whole units
the supply, on or off at each step; a cut is a run of steps with it off

ties.as: where the rebuild draws on the level, a spent unit is made from one unit of it: the stock buys the reader time under a cut (BuysTime)
the set level is kept through the reader's units, and the rule's source says where a spent unit is rebuilt from: given, the supply, the level, or nothing (Source)
while the supply is on, each unit takes one from it into the level, up to the set level (read)
one unit of the level goes out a step, no drawer named, and one more where a unit is rebuilt from the level: at most two a step under a cut

laws.lean: Becoming.ReaderRebuilding.«以储买时当且仅当取于储»

laws.then_en: Under a cut the stock buys the reader time, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the stock.
laws.then_zh: 断供之下，存量为读取者买得时间，而空的存量使读取者亡——恰在重建取于存量之时。

laws.sameness: reader present or not
laws.then_en: Under a cut, from every level of at least 2(k+1), the reader is present after k+1 steps, whatever it was at the start.

laws.sameness: reader present or not
laws.then_en: After a supplied step a present reader is still present, whatever the level before the step.

cards.misfit: The reader is one thing in three places: what the rule is read through, what needs the stock, and what draws on it. The step's own draw names no drawer. The two built cases are decided computations in the Lean file, named on the record page, that the atlas entry does not list.

cards.plain_en: A change in how situations are read makes a new correction possible only if it tells apart situations once read alike, or lets something be done that could not be.
cards.plain_zh: 改变读法，要使原先做不了的更正变得可做，必须分得开原先读作一样的情形，或让原先做不了的动作变得可行。

cast.as: the reading in force at a configuration: what each situation reads as there (reading : X → S → O)
the situations, each with the acts acceptable there, held fixed (acceptable : S → A → Prop)
a uniform policy: one act for each reading

ties.as: which situations the reading in force tells apart and which it reads alike
the policy takes its act from the reading alone; a correction is possible where such a policy is acceptable at every situation and executable at the configuration (Correctable)
a revision: a trace of the process from a configuration to one where another reading is in force (OpensAlong); a step of the process, not an answer to what the reading met

laws.sameness: a fitting uniform policy exists through the reading in force, or not
laws.then_en: A correction is possible through the reading in force exactly where each reading has one act acceptable at every situation giving it, executable there.
laws.then_zh: 经现行读法可作更正，恰在每个读数都有一个动作：对给出此读数的每个情形都可接受，且在此处可行。
laws.compare_en: one policy from readings to acts fitting every situation, against: for each reading, one act fitting every situation that gives that reading

laws.sameness: correction possible or not
laws.then_en: No course from the earlier configuration to the later opens a correction: where none was possible before, none is possible after.
laws.then_zh: 从前一处到后一处，没有进程能开出更正：先前不可更正，此后也不可更正。

laws.sameness: correction possible or not
laws.then_en: A correction possible at the earlier configuration is possible at the later one, through the revised reading.
laws.then_zh: 前一处可作的更正，改读之后在后一处仍可作。

With the link on and no stock, replenishing one unit opens the correction, the reading unchanged.
From one unit, rebuilding the link uses the last unit: the link is on, yet no correction is possible there.

cards.misfit: Near-definitional: 'a correction is possible' is that a policy from readings to acts exists, a fact at one configuration with no begins, lasts or ends and no course, so no frame fits it (one-course is the nearest); its iff is typed border though no amounts are compared. The revision is a step of a process, not a revision by what the reading met. What can be executed at a configuration has no role kind (in the built cases it is a unit of stock).

cards.plain_en: Drawing on a stock without end needs giving back without end: a cycle of revision can repeat without end exactly where each cycle gives back at least what it draws.
cards.plain_zh: 取用存量不止，就得补给不止：一轮修订能无尽重复，恰在每轮所补不少于每轮所取之时。

cast.as: a stock σ of a process, in natural numbers, balanced against each act's draw and replenishment; in ContinuingRevision, the fuel
the acts of a course, each with a draw; in ContinuingRevision every act draws at least one unit of fuel (use)
what the acts give back (replenish); in ContinuingRevision, renewal alone, giving back the yield, enabled once by a successful undertaking
in ContinuingRevision: the method and the installed reference by which an undertaking at an address is made
the address undertaken, which responds successfully or fails

ties.as: each act draws from what is held; a course is covered where each draw is within the stock then standing (Covered); a cycle of revision draws nine units
each act's replenishment; in ContinuingRevision the yield, given back at renewal
an undertaking through the installed reference responds successfully or fails (response)
the cycle: a failed undertaking at the next address, revision, two contacts, installation, a successful use, renewal (word, history)

laws.sameness: gives back at arbitrarily late steps, or not
laws.then_en: Along the run, giving back to the stock recurs: from every step on, some step gives back a positive amount.
laws.then_zh: 沿这一进程，补给一再出现：从任何一步起，总还有一步对存量有所补给。

laws.sameness: every number of cycles executable from one configuration, or not
laws.then_en: What each cycle gives back to the stock in total is at least what it draws in total.
laws.then_zh: 每一轮补给存量的总数，不少于它所取的总数。
laws.compare_en: what one cycle draws from the stock in total, against what it gives back in total

laws.sameness: an undertaking responds successfully or not
laws.then_en: Along every unending run, at every yield, successful undertakings occur at arbitrarily late steps.
laws.then_zh: 沿每一条无尽的进程，不论所补多少，成功的行事一再出现，再晚也还有。

laws.sameness: every number of revision cycles executable from one configuration, or not

laws.compare_en: the yield a renewal gives back, against the nine units one cycle of revision draws
laws.evidence: (∃ s, ∀ k, Feasible (P yield) s (history k)) ↔ 9 ≤ yield — ContinuingRevision.lean:576

laws.sameness: covered or not: each draw within the stock then standing
laws.then_en: A course can be repeated without end from a stock exactly where one pass is covered and gives back at least what it draws.
laws.then_zh: 一段进程可自某存量起无尽重复，恰在头一遍每次所取都不超当时存量、且一遍所补不少于所取之时。
laws.compare_en: each draw of the first pass against the stock then standing; what the pass gives back in total against what it draws in total
laws.evidence: (∀ k, Covered draw replenish n (repeatCourse w k)) ↔ Covered draw replenish n w ∧ total w draw ≤ total w replenish — Stock.lean:319

laws.sameness: an unending run exists or not
laws.then_en: With nothing given back, at yield zero, no unending run of the process exists, whatever the controller.
laws.then_zh: 补给既断，这一过程没有无尽的进程，不论怎样控制。
laws.evidence: theorem no_run_without_return (r : Run (P 0)) : False — ContinuingRevision.lean:476 (a case of Run.not_of_depletion: every act uses at least one unit of fuel)

built_cases.shows_en: At yield nine, five operations from a seed reach the ready configuration, and every number of cycles follows.
At yield nine, one unending run of the selected controller exists, repeating the cycle's seven operations.

cards.misfit: Two grains in one dynamic: theorems on any process with a balanced stock, and theorems on one built process. 'No unending run exists' and 'every number of cycles is executable from some configuration' say which courses exist, not that a tie begins or ends; each is placed on the nearest tie. Exit 1 drops no ledger premise (the yield is a parameter the other theorems range over), yet it says what holds at yield zero and not that the yield comes to be zero, so it is marked by_outside. ContinuingRevision's own words are uses and returns; they are written here as draws and gives back, with 'the yield' kept for the amount.

cards.plain_en: A trait sometimes lost in copying keeps its share only where its advantage in offspring exactly offsets the loss; with no advantage and any loss, its share shrinks.
cards.plain_zh: 复制中会丢失的性状，只有后代上的优势恰好抵消丢失，份额才保持；没有优势又有丢失，份额步步下降。

cast.as: the step's offspring numbers, constant: k carrying and m not for each carrier, w for each other
carriers (c) and the others (d); the carriers' share, compared across the step by cross-multiplying
the carried amount: one for a carrier, none otherwise
offspring, generation by generation, read as descent

ties.as: the offspring numbers select between carriers and the others, k carrying offspring for each carrier against w for each other, favouring carriers only where k exceeds w; the carriers' share rises, is kept or falls across a step
transmission with loss one way: m of each carrier's offspring do not carry; read as descent it lowers the amount by c·m and raises nothing (lowered_count)

laws.sameness: the carriers' share after the step against before
laws.then_en: With carriers present, the carriers' share rises across the step exactly where d·k exceeds c·m + d·w.
laws.then_zh: 携带者在场时，这一步携带者的份额上升，恰在 d·k 大于 c·m + d·w 之时。
laws.compare_en: d·k, the carrying offspring the others' number would leave at a carrier's rate, against c·m + d·w, what the step gives the others (the carriers' offspring that do not carry, and the others' offspring)
laws.evidence: (pos : 0 < c) : c * (c * k + (c * m + d * w)) < c * k * (c + d) ↔ c * m + d * w < d * k  (Becoming/Reproduction.lean)

laws.sameness: the carriers' share after the step against before
laws.then_en: With carriers present, the step keeps the carriers' share exactly where c·m + d·w equals d·k.
laws.then_zh: 携带者在场时，这一步份额不变，恰在 c·m + d·w 等于 d·k 之时。
laws.compare_en: c·m + d·w, what the step gives the others, against d·k; with k = w + s this equality is the share standing at s/(s + m), by the separate identity kept_share
laws.evidence: (pos : 0 < c) : c * (c * k + (c * m + d * w)) = c * k * (c + d) ↔ c * m + d * w = d * k  (Becoming/Reproduction.lean)

laws.sameness: balanced or not: the selection term against what transmission lowers
laws.then_en: Read as generations of descent, the first step is balanced, selection against what transmission lowers, exactly where c·m + d·w equals d·k.
laws.then_zh: 读作世代相传，第一步上选择一项与传递所减相抵，恰在 c·m + d·w 等于 d·k 之时。
laws.evidence: (pos : 0 < c) : (generations k m w c d).Balanced 0 ↔ c * m + d * w = d * k  (Becoming/Reproduction.lean; Balanced is SelectionTerm.Generations.Balanced)

laws.sameness: the carriers' share after the step against before
laws.then_en: Where k is at most w, with some loss and carriers present, the carriers' share falls across the step.
laws.then_zh: k 不大于 w，有丢失且携带者在场，这一步携带者的份额下降。
laws.compare_en: k, a carrier's carrying offspring, against w, another's offspring: the threshold; the conclusion compares the share after the step with the share before
laws.evidence: (outrun : k ≤ w) (loss : 0 < m) (pos : 0 < c) (d : Nat) : c * k * (c + d) < c * (c * k + (c * m + d * w))  (Becoming/Reproduction.lean)

laws.sameness: the carriers' share after the step against before
laws.then_en: Where k is at most w, no step raises the carriers' share, whatever the numbers of carriers, others and lost offspring.
laws.then_zh: k 不大于 w，不论携带者、其余与丢失各有多少，没有一步使携带者的份额上升。
laws.compare_en: k, a carrier's carrying offspring, against w, another's offspring
laws.evidence: (outrun : k ≤ w) (m c d : Nat) : ¬ c * (c * k + (c * m + d * w)) < c * k * (c + d)  (Becoming/Reproduction.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: One carrier, one other: at the threshold the share falls from a half; at the balance a half is kept.

cards.misfit: The theorems compare natural-number amounts across one step: 'rises, is kept, falls' is a comparison of two amounts, put here as a border on the share, not as a mark. falls_of_outrun and never_rises are sufficient, not iffs: 'border' and 'cannot' are the nearest forms. The loss m sits on passes-on as a rate; no theorem marks transmission itself, and balanced_iff, stated on the generations of descent, speaks of selection and transmission at once. The run theorems (below_always, not_falls_below, above_always: a run at or below the balance stays there with its share never falling) are left out of the principal theorems; no convergence is proved.

cards.plain_en: Mutual dependence: each can affect every other's going on, at some remove; around a loop of couplings acting every step, the difference that can arrive at least doubles each turn.
cards.plain_zh: 相互依存，是每一个都能辗转影响其余每一个的延续；在步步都起作用的耦合回路上，能到达的差异每转一圈至少翻倍。

cast.as: formations, read across all steps (or, in time, occurrences: a formation at a step)
cast.lean: F in Flow F C, Web F C

cast.as: a formation as what requires a condition: its continuation
conditions with levels; the loop's condition e and the carried amount there, the most difference that can arrive
significance held de se: from each standpoint, what lies within its center's own closure along a relation
every formation's continuation; the continuation condition is that none is left out

ties.as: affects: a formation exchanges with (takes from or gives to) a condition another depends on; at some remove, the reach closure and, read from the other end, the influence closure (Flow.Affects, Flow.AffectedBy, WithinReach, WithinInfluence)
feeds: a formation gives to a condition another requires at that step; at some remove, the feeding closure (Flow.FedFrom, WithinFeeding)
a coupling by level holding at every step: a formation outside the part exchanges with one condition with positive strength on another's current level (CouplesAlways); a loop of m + 1 of them
the reading holds every formation's continuation, or leaves some out (Unrestricted)

laws.sameness: within the closure or beyond it, read across all steps
laws.then_en: Every formation lies within every formation's influence closure exactly where every formation lies within every formation's reach closure, read across all steps.
laws.then_zh: 每个形成都能辗转受每个形成影响，恰在每个形成都能辗转影响每个形成之时；跨所有步而读。
laws.evidence: L.MutuallyDependent W ↔ ∀ f g, L.WithinReach W f g  (Becoming/MutualDependence.lean)

laws.sameness: within the closure or beyond it, read across all steps
laws.then_en: Where every formation lies within every formation's feeding closure, every formation lies within every formation's influence closure, across all steps.
laws.then_zh: 每个形成的延续都辗转靠每个形成所给，则每个形成都能辗转受每个形成影响；跨所有步而读。
laws.evidence: (fed : L.MutuallyFed W) : L.MutuallyDependent W  (Becoming/MutualDependence.lean)

laws.sameness: the reading holds a continuation or leaves it out
laws.then_en: With every formation a center, each center's own closure, along affecting or being affected, holds every continuation exactly where the flow is mutually dependent.
laws.then_zh: 每个形成都是中心时，各中心沿“影响”或“受影响”的自身闭包涵盖一切延续，恰在此流相互依存之时。
laws.evidence: (onto : ∀ f, ∃ p, center p = f) : (L.MutuallyDependent W ↔ Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure (L.AffectedBy W)) center)) ∧ (L.MutuallyDependent W ↔ Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure (L.Affects W)) center))  (Becoming/FlowCenters.lean)

laws.sameness: the carried amount at a condition: the most difference that can arrive there
laws.then_en: R turns after step T, the carried amount at the loop's condition is at least 2^R times that at T, at most D(1+M)^(T+(m+1)R).
laws.then_zh: 自第 T 步起转 R 圈后，回路上那个缘的所载之量至少是第 T 步时的 2^R 倍，至多 D(1+M)^(T+(m+1)R)。
laws.compare_en: the carried amount at the loop's condition e at step T + (m + 1)·R, against 2^R times the carried amount there at step T, and against D·(1 + M)^(T + (m + 1)·R)
laws.evidence: 2 ^ R * carried cs part (fun _ _ _ => 0) k present δ T e ≤ carried … δ (T + (m + 1) * R) e ∧ carried … δ (T + (m + 1) * R) e ≤ D * (1 + M) ^ (T + (m + 1) * R)  (Becoming/MutualDependence.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: A pair mutually dependent across all steps is so in time from step 0 and not from step 1.
Two formations each take from what the other requires: the condition holds along affecting and being affected, not along feeding.
In Clearing, every formation its own center, neither the closure under affecting nor under being affected holds every continuation.

cards.misfit: Affecting and feeding are composites (an exchange with a stock, then needs), and the theorems speak of their closures 'at some remove'; the kinds have no tie for a closure and none for sharing a stock, so the third reading (sharesThroughout) is left out, and feeding sits on gives-to though nothing in it waits. The closure theorems are timeless, with no mark and no amount: 'same-as' and 'order' are the nearest forms. exponential_around bounds the carried amount, the most difference that can arrive, on both sides; it is typed border though it is not an iff, and it does not take mutual dependence as a premise: the pace is not given by mutual dependence. The de se theorems need a standpoint and its center, which 'reading' holds loosely; which relation and which standpoints are readings. The in-time theorems (MutuallyDependentFrom) and the root's condition on a net are not among the principal theorems; both exits are witnesses and are under built cases.

cards.plain_en: Endless arising that depletes a stock needs renewal that never stops for good; with ever more takers, no bound on giving back, or on the number of limited givers, lasts.
cards.plain_zh: 生起不息而使存量下降，更新就不能永远停下；取用者不断增多，补给就没有长久的上界；每个更新者给量有限时，更新者的数目也没有。

cast.as: a finite family of conditions and its total level
takers: the formations taking from the family across a step, each at least one unit; more without end where, for every K, from some step on at least K take at every step
renewers: the formations giving to the family across a step, each at most a fixed amount g; replenishment is everything given to it
a formation arising: not active at a step, active at the next; unceasing where this happens at arbitrarily late steps

ties.as: replenishment of the family across a step, and how many renewers give; a level's rise made by an active renewer (RenewedBy)
uptake from the family across a step, and how many takers take; arising that depletes the family (Depletes)

laws.sameness: still or rising: whether any level of the family rises across a step
laws.then_en: The family cannot, from any step on, stay still (none of its conditions rising); the theorem names no step of rising.
laws.then_zh: 这族缘不能从任何一步起永远不升；此定理不指明哪一步上升。
laws.evidence: (depletes : W.Depletes cs fun t => ∃ f, W.Arises t f) (unceasing : W.Unceasing) (T : Nat) : ¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → W.Still cs t  (Becoming/Arising.lean)

laws.sameness: replenishment across a step at or below a bound
laws.then_en: For every bound R and every step, the family's replenishment does not stay at or below R from that step on.
laws.then_zh: 对任何上界 R 和任何一步，这族缘所得的补给不会从那步起一直不超过 R。
laws.evidence: (balances : L.Balances W) (more : L.More cs) (R T₀ : Nat) : ¬ ∀ t, T₀ ≤ t → L.replenishment cs t ≤ R  (Becoming/Flow.lean)

laws.sameness: number of renewers across a step at or below a bound
laws.then_en: For every bound M and step, the number of renewers of the family does not stay at or below M from that step on.
laws.then_zh: 对任何上界 M 和任何一步，给这族缘的更新者数目不会从那步起一直不超过 M。
laws.evidence: (balances : L.Balances W) (capacity : L.Capacity cs g) (more : L.More cs) (M T₀ : Nat) : ¬ ∀ t, T₀ ≤ t → L.renewers cs t ≤ M  (Becoming/Flow.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: More without end, each giving at most one unit, yet at arbitrarily late steps no renewer gives and nothing replenishes.
With takes that halve, takers are more without end while one whole given each step balances them: no least take.
A closed cycle whose total stays one sustains unceasing arising; active renewing stops from no step on.

cards.misfit: The conclusions are negative forms ('from no step on', 'no bound from any step on') that name no step of giving back; no mark fits, so 'cannot' is the nearest form, and reading them as 'again and again' or 'ever more at every step' says more than the Lean (Pulse). A 'needs' theorem in negative form sits between 'shows' and 'cannot': Unceasing.rises is typed 'shows' on the card of unceasing-generation-needs-renewal. In Unceasing.rises the renewal is a rise of a level with no giver named, and the depletion premise does not involve the arising formation. 'More' is a number of drawers, of role-fillers; the kinds have it only as an amount on draws-on. Natural-number amounts is kept among the ifs here because the least take of one unit carries the theorem (Halving). Left out of the principal theorems: activeRenewer_recurs, uptake_needs_replenishment, and More.unceasing (more forces unceasing arising under a census).

cards.plain_en: A finite family of stocks that keeps being drawn on, each taker giving back less than it takes, cannot from any step on be fed only from within.
cards.plain_zh: 一族有限的存量不断被取，而每个取用者所还都少于所取，它就不能从任何一步起只靠内部给养。

cast.as: a finite family of conditions, listed without repetition, enclosed around from some step on; the conditions outside it are what lies beyond
the formations taking from the family, at arbitrarily late steps; under dissipation each gives a closed family at least one unit less than it takes
a formation that gives to a member of the family; it conveys from beyond where it takes from a condition outside the family
an embodied relatum: it stands as a condition exactly while it is active, so it fills pattern and stock at once; its arising

ties.as: giving to the family: its replenishment across a step; fed from beyond where what is given was taken from a condition outside it (FedFromBeyond); inward where every giver to it takes only from within (Inward), the exact opposite with equality decided
closed across a step: no formation taking part takes from or gives to a condition outside the family (ClosedAt)
taking from the family at arbitrarily late steps (takers recur)

laws.sameness: fed from beyond across a step, or not
laws.then_en: From no step on is the family fed from nothing beyond it; the theorem names no step at which it is fed.
laws.then_zh: 这族缘不能从任何一步起全无外来之给；此定理不指明哪一步有外来之给。
laws.evidence: (balances : L.Balances W) (dissipative : L.Dissipative) (distinct : Distinct ds) (around : ∀ t, T₀ ≤ t → L.Around ds t) (recurs : ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ 0 < L.takers ds t) (N : Nat) : ¬ ∀ t, N ≤ t → ¬ L.FedFromBeyond ds t  (Becoming/Continuation.lean)

laws.sameness: closed across a step, or not
laws.then_en: From no step on is the family, or any finite family without repetition containing it, closed across every step.
laws.then_zh: 这族缘，和任何包含它的有限无重复之族，都不能从任何一步起步步封闭。
laws.evidence: (distinct : Distinct ds) (within : ∀ c, c ∈ cs → c ∈ ds) (recurs : ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ 0 < L.takers cs t) (T : Nat) : ¬ ∀ t, T ≤ t → L.ClosedAt ds t  (Becoming/Dissipation.lean)

laws.sameness: replenishment across the step positive or not
laws.then_en: Across the step at which an embodied member arises, the family is given to: its replenishment is positive, whatever is taken.
laws.then_zh: 具身成员生起的那一步，这族缘得到补给：补给为正，不论被取多少。
laws.evidence: (balances : L.Balances W) {x : X} (embodied : W.Embodied x) {cs : List X} (mem : x ∈ cs) {t : Nat} (arises : W.Arises t x) : 0 < L.replenishment cs t  (Becoming/Roles.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: A pool is fed from beyond at every step while no fuel is conveyed from after its own step.
Without dissipation, two embodied sides hand one standing back and forth: closed at every step, arising unceasing.
Unit splitting without end: a closed dissipative pool is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, unbalanced at the fixed unit.

cards.misfit: 'Beyond' is not a role: the conditions outside the family are other stocks, told apart by membership in a list, so 'fed from beyond' is drawn on gives-back and 'closed' on crosses between the family and the rest. The conclusions are negative forms that name no step of feeding; read as 'fed again and again' they would say more than the Lean. Closed (ClosedAt) and enclosed around (Around) are two samenesses of crosses the kinds do not tell apart. Embodied.replenishes is typed 'shows' (an arising read back to the giving it took); its giving need not come from beyond. Left out of the principal theorems: inward_iff_not_fed (an iff, near-definitional), the rising and embodied-arising forms, and the finite-whole theorems (no recurring taking or embodied arising where finitely many are all there is).

cards.plain_en: While each step draws something, no more than the stock is given back, forming never stops; always drawing more wears the giving down, and all forming on that stock ends.
cards.plain_zh: 每步有所取而不超过更新率，形成就步步不息；一直超过，更新被磨损，共用这份存量的形成到一定步数都止。

cast.as: the formation: what one continuing activity forms at each step; forming something at every step is Ceaseless
the conditions held (stock); counted together with what the rate can still supply as the budget (stock + tri renew)
the renewing organization and its rate (renew), changed only by a supplied wear law with no recovery
formation pressure, the activity's draw at each step (demand); one part's draw, another's, and their joint draw (own, other)
formation sharing the conditions: any share of what forms under the joint draw
cast.lean: share n ≤ formed law c0 total n

ties.as: a step forms its draw, limited by the stock held plus the rate (formedAt = min d (stock + renew)), and takes what forms from them; a draw beyond the rate also wears the rate
the rate is added to the stock held each step; under the wear law it holds under a draw within it, falls (if positive) under a draw beyond it, and never rises
formation sharing the conditions: its share at each step is at most what forms under the joint draw

laws.sameness: forming something at the step or not
laws.then_en: The formation forms something at every step of the course.
laws.then_zh: 此进程每一步都有所成。
laws.compare_en: each step's draw against one and against the initial rate
laws.evidence: (within : WithinRenewal c0 demand) : Ceaseless law c0 demand — universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean:178

laws.sameness: rate at its initial value or not
laws.then_en: The rate of giving back stays at its initial value at every step exactly where no step's draw exceeds that initial rate.
laws.then_zh: 更新率步步守在初值，恰在没有一步所取超过初始更新率之时。
laws.compare_en: each step's draw against the initial rate of giving back; a draw of zero is allowed
laws.evidence: (positive : 1 ≤ c0.renew) : KeepsCapacity law c0 demand ↔ ∀ n, demand n ≤ c0.renew — RenewingFormation.lean:480

laws.sameness: forming something at the step or not
laws.then_en: Nothing forms at any step from the budget step on: the forming ends for good on this course.
laws.then_zh: 自预算步起每一步都无所成：此进程上的形成自此而亡，不复。
laws.compare_en: the step against the budget: the stock held plus the triangular number of the initial rate (budget c0 = c0.stock + tri c0.renew)
laws.evidence: (beyond : BeyondCurrent law c0 demand) : ∀ n, budget c0 ≤ n → formed law c0 demand n = 0 — RenewingFormation.lean:257

laws.sameness: rate at its initial value or not
laws.then_en: After the first step the rate of giving back is below its initial value at every step: the keeping ends at once, for good.
laws.then_zh: 第一步之后，更新率步步低于初值：所守即刻而亡，不复。
laws.compare_en: the first step's draw against the initial rate
laws.evidence: (positive : 1 ≤ c0.renew) (excess : c0.renew < demand 0) : ∀ k, (path law c0 demand (1 + k)).renew < c0.renew — RenewingFormation.lean:494

laws.sameness: a share of what forms positive or nothing
laws.then_en: Each part alone forms at every step; under their joint draw every share of what forms is nothing from the budget step on.
laws.then_zh: 两部分各自独取，步步有所成；合取之下，所成的每一份自预算步起都为零。
laws.compare_en: each part's draw against the initial rate (within it), and the two draws together against it (beyond it at every step)
laws.evidence: (ownWithin : WithinRenewal c0 own) (otherWithin : WithinRenewal c0 other) (joint : BeyondRenewal c0 (fun k => own k + other k)) (allocated : ∀ n, share n ≤ formed law c0 (fun k => own k + other k) n) : Ceaseless law c0 own ∧ Ceaseless law c0 other ∧ ∀ n, budget c0 ≤ n → share n = 0 — RenewingFormation.lean:370

laws.sameness: total formed up to the step
laws.then_en: At every step past the budget, the course within the rate has formed more in total than the course beyond the current rate.
laws.then_zh: 过了预算步，每一步上，守在更新率之内的进程所成的总量，都多于超出当前更新率的进程。
laws.compare_en: the total formed up to a step on a course within the rate against the total on a course beyond the current rate, same start and same wear law, at steps past the budget; one-way, not an iff
laws.evidence: (within : WithinRenewal c0 own) (beyond : BeyondCurrent law c0 demand) : ∀ n, budget c0 < n → cumulative law c0 demand n < cumulative law c0 own n — RenewingFormation.lean:411

built_cases.shows_en: With a held stock and positive rate, a surge forms more at the first step than drawing at the rate.
Resting one step keeps the rate, yet something does not form at every step.
A surge, then a draw within the lowered rate, forms at every step though the initial rate is lost.

cards.misfit: The rate is both what gives back and something the draw wears down, and the budget counts stock and rate as one amount; the kinds hold this only as two ties on one stock. 'Lasts' has two samenesses here that the witnesses separate (forming at every step; rate kept). within_eventually_exceeds_every_beyond is a one-way comparison of totals past a step, filed as border though it is no iff. consuming_forms_more_first is general over starts with a held stock and positive rate (it also states the later reversal that law 6 carries); listed as a built case because it constructs the surge and the six-theorem limit is reached. The exits' draw beyond the rate is supplied, not shown to come about.

cards.plain_en: A regularity that is kept can always be kept one step more; a line of continuation ends only by a step that leaves its regularity.
cards.plain_zh: 守住的规律总能再守一步；一条相续的线要亡，必经离开这规律的一步。

cast.as: occurrences x, y of any carrier; a relation R by which one conditions another; a relation or class E; E's core (the greatest symmetric relation inside E constant under R); a line under E
cast.lean: Becoming.«续», Becoming.«相续», Becoming.«核», Becoming.«亡», Becoming.«不穷»

laws.sameness: alike under E's core
laws.then_en: Every occurrence the line under the core reaches from this step's end, that end included, has a successor under the core.
laws.then_zh: 从这一步之末起，核下之线所到的每一处（此末在内），在核下都有后续。
laws.evidence: (kept : «续» R («核» R E) x y) : «不穷» R («核» R E) y — becoming/Becoming/GrammarRegularity.lean:86

laws.sameness: alike under E
laws.then_en: The line's last occurrence has a successor under E: it does not end there.
laws.then_zh: 线的末处在 E 下仍有后续：不亡于此。
laws.evidence: (line : «相续» R («核» R E) x y) : «有后» R E y — GrammarRegularity.lean:111

laws.sameness: alike under E (kept by the step) and alike under E's core (not kept)
laws.then_en: The step into the end continues under E and is not alike under E's core: it leaves the core.
laws.then_zh: 入亡的这一步在 E 下相续，在 E 的核下却不同：这一步离了核。
laws.evidence: (c : «续» R E x y) (ends : «亡» R E y) : «异» R E («核» R E) x y — GrammarRegularity.lean:118

laws.sameness: alike under E (kept by the step) and alike under E's core (not kept)
laws.then_en: The line's last step, from its start or from an occurrence it reaches, continues under E and leaves E's core.
laws.then_zh: 此线的末步（出自线始或线上所到之处）在 E 下相续，而离了 E 的核。
laws.evidence: (line : «相续» R E x y) (ends : «亡» R E y) : ∃ w, «异» R E («核» R E) w y ∧ (x = w ∨ «相续» R E x w) — GrammarRegularity.lean:125

laws.sameness: alike under E's core
laws.then_en: The line's start and its end are not alike under E's core.
laws.then_zh: 此线的始与末在 E 的核下不同。
laws.evidence: (hE : «类» E) (line : «相续» R E x y) (ends : «亡» R E y) : ¬ «核» R E x y — GrammarRegularity.lean:132

laws.sameness: alike under E
laws.then_en: Along a determined law, the line from the start never ends under E exactly where every step of its orbit continues under E.
laws.then_zh: 沿一条确定的律，自起点的线在 E 下永不亡，恰在其轨的每一步在 E 下都相续之时。
laws.evidence: «不穷» (step next) E s ↔ ∀ n, E (orbit next s n) (orbit next s (n + 1)) — GrammarRegularity.lean:146

cards.misfit: Theorems about every carrier, relation and class: no role or tie is named. 'A step leaves the core' is a change said under two samenesses at once (it continues under E, it differs under E's core), which one sameness field holds only as a phrase; the conclusion of «亡前核变» is the root's own 异, so tie with mark changes would fit as well as 'shows', which was kept for the three theorems read backward from an end and carries no mark. The rule for mechanism theorems gives two of them 'sufficient' though they state what an end requires. unending_iff_steps is an iff that is not in amounts or times, filed as tie with strength exact. 'Has a successor' is some continuation, not every branch.

cards.plain_en: No course ever leaves a region exactly when some set inside it, closed under every step, contains the start; none leaves two regions' overlap exactly when none leaves either.

cards.misfit: Half legend, half place, which one legend flag cannot say. The first four theorems here (Viability, JointKeeping, Lasting) hold of every process and guard, name no roles and belong to the legend; the last two (MarketInstances, PartialRegimeTransition) are one model's instances, with a stock, a share and a rule. Marked not-legend so the market's roles show; the four general theorems carry about_role any. A certificate, a ladder and a closed set avoiding a target are existence statements over sets, which no role holds. The four general iffs are not in amounts or times (filed as tie, exact). lands_iff_margin speaks of every start of one determined law, between one-course and every-course; as an iff it states both sides, and by_outside marks only its exit reading (β above 5/12). Quality, influence and β are the rule's own changing state, which 'rule' holds only loosely. No theorem says the intervention (β held fixed, support supplied) comes about. Left out for the six-theorem limit: never_leaves_iff_certificate, supported_finite_transition (the case β = 0 of the sixth theorem), no_uniform_pulse_duration, cover_exact.

cards.misfit: The continuation that names the dynamic (trained workers reviewing the next, the first reviewer gone) is shown only in one declared history, so no general theorem here is about passes-on. Presence, the roster, enrollment by ballot and the mandate are an organization's own steps that the kinds hold only as 'parts'; admission is not a tie. round_iff is an iff in memberships and equalities, not amounts, filed as tie with mark changes; round_trains says the accord holds after the round, which 'begins' slightly overstates (it may have held before). trained_along speaks of the course's end, not every step.
