finishing the work left (the publication); the reserved stop
the device's evidence: its tracked bookkeeping and its pending record
the device's actual configuration

ties.as: one unit of fuel for one unit of work a tick; each admitted move lowers the margin by one or takes the exit
finishing needs the fuel to cover the work left plus one; the stop keeps three units and three steps in reserve
safety: the evidence coherent, a ready device's bookkeeping covering the actual configuration (Safe)

laws.sameness: the property holds, or not
laws.then_en: A property lasts to the end of every admitted course, from every start where it holds, exactly where every admitted step keeps it.
laws.then_zh: 一个性质从它成立的每个起点、沿每段被允许的进程住到末尾，恰在每个被允许的步都守住它之时。
laws.evidence: (∀ s a t, allow s a → f s a = some t → I s → I t) ↔ ∀ s t, Reach (admitted f allow) s t → I s → I t  (Becoming/Countdown.lean)

laws.sameness: the evidence coherent (safe), or not
laws.then_en: From a safe start, the device stays safe, its evidence coherent, to the end of every course of its admitted steps, interruptions included.
laws.then_zh: 从安全的起点起，沿装置每段被允许的进程（中断也算），证据的相容一直住到末尾。
laws.evidence: ∀ s t, Reach recoverable s t → RecoverableControl.Safe s → RecoverableControl.Safe t  (universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ProtocolInstances.lean)

laws.sameness: finished after work + 1 steps, or not
laws.then_en: A pending task finishes in work+1 steps exactly where the fuel covers work+1 units.
laws.then_zh: 待办的任务走 work+1 步做完，恰在燃料够付 work+1 个单位之时。
laws.compare_en: the work left plus one, against the fuel
laws.evidence: (∃ t, ticks tick (work s + 1) s = some t ∧ done t) ↔ work s + 1 ≤ fuel s  (Becoming/Countdown.lean)

laws.sameness: published after n + 1 resumed steps, or not
laws.then_en: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n+1 resumed steps exactly where the reserve covers n+1 units and the deadline n+1 more steps.
laws.then_zh: 余下 n 次写入与发布经 n+1 个续行的步完成，恰在储备够 n+1 个单位、离期限还有 n+1 步之时。
laws.compare_en: the writes left plus one, against the units of reserve, and against the steps left before the deadline
laws.evidence: (∃ m, RecoverableControl.resumeSteps (r.todo.length + 1) (.busy r) = some (.ready m)) ↔ r.todo.length + 1 ≤ …state.reserve ∧ …state.time + r.todo.length + 1 ≤ …state.deadline  (universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ProtocolInstances.lean)

laws.sameness: at the exit, or short of it
laws.then_en: From a valid start, every admitted course longer than the margin is at the exit at its end, and valid there.
laws.then_zh: 从有效的起点起，每段长于余量的被允许进程，末了都在出口，且在那里有效。
laws.compare_en: the course's number of steps, against the margin at the start; a course exactly as long as the margin misses the exit in one built case (Becoming.Countdown.Slow.misses)
laws.evidence: ∀ (plan : List A) (s : S), valid s → (∀ a, a ∈ plan → adm a) → margin s < plan.length → ∃ t, runPartial f s plan = some t ∧ valid t ∧ exit t  (Becoming/Countdown.lean)

laws.sameness: stopped, or still running
laws.then_en: From an armed device, every admissible schedule longer than the reserve above three units ends with the supervisor stopped, the device safe and stopped.
laws.then_zh: 从待命的装置起，凡长于储备超出三单位之数的可容许调度，终了时监督已停，装置安全且已停。
laws.compare_en: the schedule's number of steps, against the units of reserve above the three reserved
laws.evidence: (long : (state d).reserve - 3 < events.length) : ∃ out, ReservedShutdown.run events (.active g bound d) = some (.stopped out) ∧ RecoverableControl.Safe out ∧ Stopped out  (universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ProtocolInstances.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: Nine units, no reserved stop: after the first write nothing is published, shutdown is refused, the activity still runs.
Deleting the pending marker publishes old bookkeeping whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over them accepts.
An interruption of ten against a bound of one breaks completion: the run goes on with no stop left executable.

cards.misfit: admitted_invariant_iff holds of every partial law and names no role (the legend's kind) inside a card that has roles; counted work and a reserved exit are likewise theorems on any partial law, and fuel and margin are a stock only through the instance. exits and schedule_stops are one-way pace bounds (steps against a margin), written as border with strength sufficient: no form holds a threshold without 'exactly where'. That what runs then ends, and stays ended, is the instance's reading (the supervisor stopped) together with Reserved.kept, not these theorems' conclusion; the exit is any predicate the moves keep. The device's fuel is two amounts at once, units of reserve and steps before a deadline (a time). The stop grant's authority is supplied; no kind holds it.

cards.plain_en: When a run-down stock regrows faster than the future is discounted, every best plan takes nothing until it has regrown, and what depended on it is supplied again.
cards.plain_zh: 耗低的存量若长得比权重降得快，每个最优都先不取、等它长回；它长到够处，依者又得其所需。

cast.as: a condition's level, at or below y: the depleted base
the renewal law R: a level z stands at z + R z before the draw
the part whose courses are open: each step leaves at most what stands and draws at most the capacity k
any order over courses rising with the weighted draw across n + 1 steps
the courses open from the start; the optima among them
a formation depending on the condition at a need, as it stands at the start

ties.as: what a course draws at each step: what stands less what it leaves, weighted by w
the renewal: the next level z + R z rises with the level up to y
the order's optima: open courses that no open course betters (Frontier)
a dependence on the condition at a need; restored where the level meets that need within a number of steps (RestoredWithin)

laws.sameness: draws at the step, or draws nothing
laws.then_en: Every optimum draws nothing at each step to the n-th after which the rising level is still below y, and stands at that level.
laws.then_zh: 到第 n 步为止，凡走后上升水平仍低于 y 的步，每个最优都不取，并正处在那个水平。
laws.evidence: ∀ t, t < n → rise R y s (t + 1) < y → x (t + 1) = rise R y s (t + 1) ∧ x (t + 1) = x t + R (x t)  (Becoming/Optimum.lean)

laws.sameness: the need met by the level, or not
laws.then_en: Every dependence whose need, as at the start, the rising level meets by step j+1 is met within j+1 steps on every optimum.
laws.then_zh: 凡起点时的所需为第 j+1 步的上升水平所及的依存，在每个最优上都于 j+1 步之内得其所需。
laws.compare_en: the need as it stands at the start, against the rising course's level at step j + 1, which is the stock's level there
laws.evidence: ∀ f j, j < n → Optimum.rise R y s (j + 1) < y → W.need 0 f c ≤ Optimum.rise R y s (j + 1) → W.RestoredWithin (j + 1) 0 f c  (Becoming/Optimum.lean)

laws.sameness: bettered by an open course, or not
laws.then_en: No open course draws more, weighted over n+1 steps, than the course rising as fast as renewal allows to y, then leaving nothing.
laws.then_zh: 从起点开放的进程里，没有哪条在 n+1 步的加权所取上多过那条随补给尽快升到 y、末了不留的进程。
laws.evidence: Frontier (OpenCourse R k s) (fun b a => weightedOver w R a (n + 1) < weightedOver w R b (n + 1)) (rebuilding R y s n)  (Becoming/Optimum.lean)

laws.sameness: the level at y, or not
laws.then_en: Every optimum leaves the stock at y at each step to the n-th where the rising course stands at y.
laws.then_zh: 到第 n 步为止，凡上升进程已到 y 的步，每个最优都把存量留在 y。
laws.evidence: ∀ t, t < n → rise R y s (t + 1) = y → x (t + 1) = y  (Becoming/Optimum.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: Stock doubling to eight: weights falling by less than half a step, every optimum rebuilds it; by more, ends it.
Weights falling exactly by half: rebuilding and ending the stock at once are both optima.

cards.misfit: 'Is an optimum' has no mark: rebuilding_frontier is written as cannot (no open course draws more, weighted). RestoredWithin (the need met at some step within a window) is a one-way comparison of amounts, written as border with strength sufficient; it does not say the need was unmet before. The weights w, how the order counts later draws against earlier ones, have no kind of their own; they are part of the rule. The atlas's one exit is a witness (the same doubling_rebuilds), kept as a built case.

cards.plain_en: Down a lineage a goal lasts only as each descent passes it on; needs inherited within a bound drift at most that bound per descent; inheritance adds no new dependence.
cards.plain_zh: 世系之中，目标要每次承传都传到才传得下去；所需若每次至多涨一个定数，传几次就至多涨几个；承继不添新的依存。

cast.as: what a lineage carries: a goal (any predicate of steps and formations), or a dependence on c
the lineage's members xs 0, xs 1, …: each takes part, gives to the next, and the next comes to stand
cast.lean: L.DescendsAt W t x g; W.ComesToStand

cast.as: a member depending on c at a need
cast.lean: W.requires t x c; W.need t x c

cast.as: the condition c and its level

ties.as: descent: across a step a member gives to another, which comes to stand; a goal passed at each descent and kept until giving
a member's dependence on c and its need: inherited at a descent (InheritsAt), within δ (NeedsWithinAt), transmitted (TransmitsWithin, TransmitsFromSome)

laws.sameness: carries the goal, or not
laws.then_en: A goal lasts down every lineage keeping it until giving, from a carrying founder, exactly where it passes at every descent from a carrier.
laws.then_zh: 目标从带着它的始祖起，沿每条在给出前守住它的世系一直传下去，恰在每次由带它者承传都把它传到之时。
laws.evidence: (∀ t x g, L.DescendsAt W t x g → carries t g → carries (t + 1) x) ↔ ∀ xs ts n, (∀ i, i < n → L.DescendsAt W (ts i) (xs (i + 1)) (xs i)) → (kept until giving) → carries (ts 0) (xs 0) → ∀ i, i < n → carries (ts i + 1) (xs (i + 1))  (Becoming/Evolution.lean)

laws.sameness: the need for c, within a bound
laws.then_en: After i+1 descents the member's need for c at its first standing step is at most the founder's need plus (i+1) times δ.
laws.then_zh: 经 i+1 次承传，成员初立那一步对 c 的所需，至多是始祖给出时的所需加 (i+1)·δ。
laws.compare_en: the need after i + 1 descents, against the founder's need at its giving step plus (i + 1) times δ
laws.evidence: ∀ i, i < n → W.need (ts i + 1) (xs (i + 1)) c ≤ W.need (ts 0) (xs 0) c + (i + 1) * δ  (Becoming/Evolution.lean)

laws.sameness: the need for c, against the condition's level
laws.then_en: The need after i+1 descents is at most the condition's level at the founder's giving step plus (i+1) times δ.
laws.then_zh: 经 i+1 次承传，所需至多是始祖给出那一步 c 的水平加 (i+1)·δ。
laws.compare_en: the need after i + 1 descents, against the condition's level at the founder's giving step plus (i + 1) times δ
laws.evidence: (founder : W.Supported (ts 0) (xs 0)) (pos : 0 < n) : ∀ i, i < n → W.need (ts i + 1) (xs (i + 1)) c ≤ W.level (ts 0) c + (i + 1) * δ  (Becoming/Evolution.lean)

laws.sameness: transmitted within δ at the descent, or not
laws.then_en: At one descent, a dependence on c is transmitted within δ exactly where it is inherited and the need is within δ.
laws.then_zh: 在一次承传上，对 c 的依存在 δ 内传递，恰在它是承继来的、所需又在 δ 之内之时。
laws.evidence: (W.requires (t + 1) x c → W.requires t g c ∧ W.need (t + 1) x c ≤ W.need t g c + δ) ↔ W.InheritsAt t x g c ∧ W.NeedsWithinAt t x g c δ  (Becoming/Transmission.lean)

laws.sameness: depends on c, or not
laws.then_en: What comes to stand across the step does not depend on c at the step after.
laws.then_zh: 跨这一步而立者，下一步不依存 c：这一依存不生。
laws.evidence: (none : ∀ g, g ∈ L.present t → ¬ W.requires t g c) (comes : W.ComesToStand t x) : ¬ W.requires (t + 1) x c  (Becoming/Transmission.lean)

laws.sameness: the need for c, against the condition's level
laws.then_en: What comes to stand depending on c needs it at most the condition's level at the giving step plus δ.
laws.then_zh: 依存 c 而初立者，其所需至多是给出那一步 c 的水平加 δ。
laws.compare_en: the need at the first standing step, against the condition's level at the giving step plus δ
laws.evidence: (transmits : L.TransmitsFromSome W c δ) (comes : W.ComesToStand t x) (depends : W.requires (t + 1) x c) : W.need (t + 1) x c ≤ W.level t c + δ  (Becoming/Transmission.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: Two givers, one depending on the pool: transmission from some giver holds; transmission within δ fails for every δ.

cards.misfit: One-way bounds on a need (drift per descent; a need at most a level plus δ) are written as border with strength sufficient: no form holds 'at most' without 'exactly where'. transmits_at_iff unpacks one condition into two within one model; same-as, meant for another model, is the nearest form. A goal is any predicate of steps and formations: goal_along (not listed; the forward half of goal_descends_iff) uses no descent and is of the legend's kind. In descent the giving is to another member, not to a stock; it is read as passes-on, and the web has no tie for a need passing from one dependent to another. Transmission is a premise wherever it enters; no theorem here derives it from descent, so the drift per descent is a condition, not a result.

cards.plain_en: Selection within a line of descent, measured step by step, does not settle whether the line goes on or ends, unless it is at work again and again without end.
cards.plain_zh: 世系之内的选择，一步一步量出来，并不决定这条世系是延是亡；除非它一再起作用，没有尽头。

cast.as: a line of descent: cohorts, each listed as the offspring of the last
the members of a cohort, each with its listed offspring
offspring number, the weight selection proper goes by
the members of a cohort with their amounts (the same members, in a second role)

ties.as: the line goes on where every later cohort has a member and ends where every cohort is empty from some step on; a member degenerates (退化) where every branch from it ends
the selection term proper: concordance and discordance of offspring number with an amount among a cohort's members (concordAt, discordAt)

laws.sameness: concordance and discordance at the step
laws.then_en: Both have the same concordance and discordance at that step; the second's next cohort is larger by k for each member.
laws.then_zh: 两者在这一步的同向项与反向项都相同；后者的下一代，每个成员多出 k 个。
laws.evidence: G'.concordAt t = G.concordAt t ∧ G'.discordAt t = G.discordAt t ∧ G'.size (t + 1) = G.size (t + 1) + G.size t * k (Becoming/SelectionShift.lean)

laws.sameness: every cohort with a member, or empty from some step on
laws.then_en: Two courses keeping its cohorts and terms through the horizon share terms at every step; one never empties, one is empty from H+2 on.
laws.then_zh: 有两条进程，到视界 H 为止与它同代、同选择项，且两者步步选择项相同：一条代代不空，一条自 H+2 起皆空。
laws.evidence: (nonempty : 0 < G.size H) : … (∀ t, (ending G H).concordAt t = (goingShifted G H).concordAt t ∧ …) ∧ (∀ t, 0 < (goingShifted G H).size t) ∧ (∀ n, (ending G H).size (H + 2 + n) = 0) (Becoming/SelectionShift.lean)

laws.sameness: every cohort with a member, or empty from some step on
laws.then_en: Some course with the same terms at every step is never empty, and some course with them is empty from some step on.
laws.then_zh: 有一条步步选择项相同的进程代代不空，也有一条自某步起皆空。
laws.evidence: ∃ G₁ G₂ : SelectionTerm.Generations α, SameTerms G G₁ ∧ SameTerms G G₂ ∧ (∀ t, 0 < G₁.size t) ∧ ∃ m, ∀ n, G₂.size (m + n) = 0 (Becoming/SelectionShift.lean)

laws.sameness: a cohort with a member, or empty
laws.then_en: Every cohort of the line has a member, the first included: the line lasts, passing on, at every step.
laws.then_zh: 这条世系每一代都有成员，第一代也在内：步步皆住，代代相传。
laws.evidence: (pos : ∀ t, ∃ s, t ≤ s ∧ (0 < G.concordAt s ∨ 0 < G.discordAt s)) : ∀ t, 0 < G.size t (Becoming/SelectionShift.lean)

laws.sameness: a cohort with a member, or empty
laws.then_en: Every later cohort has a member, and at each step from it on some member has an offspring: the line lasts from then on.
laws.then_zh: 此后每一代都有成员，且自这一步起步步都有成员留下后代：世系自此而住。
laws.evidence: (exact : ∀ s, t ≤ s → Exact (G.family s) (G.kids s) (G.amount s) (G.amount (s + 1))) (pos : 0 < G.concordAt t) : (∀ n, ∃ q, q ∈ G.family (t + n) ∧ 0 < G.offspringNumber (t + n) q) ∧ ∀ n, 0 < G.size (t + n + 1) (Becoming/SelectionShift.lean)

laws.sameness: ending on every branch (退化), or not
laws.then_en: Every member of the cohort ends on every branch exactly where some cohort from that step on is empty.
laws.then_zh: 这一代的成员条条支线皆尽（退化），恰在自这一步起某一代为空之时。
laws.compare_en: the size of some cohort from that step on, against zero
laws.evidence: (∀ p, p ∈ G.family t → «退化» (Web.continuationStep R) Lc (t, p)) ↔ ∃ N, t ≤ N ∧ G.size N = 0 (Becoming/LineageRegions.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: Exact only at step 0 and concordant there: one member at cohorts 1 and 2, empty from cohort 3.
For every N: term positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, empty from N+1.
Reproduction stops after H: term positive at every nonempty cohort but the last; every member of every cohort degenerates.

cards.misfit: The selection term is a count over pairs of members in one cohort, not a rule that picks: 'selects' with offspring number as the rule is the nearest tie. two_fates_of_nonempty and eventually_zero_two_fates say that courses with the same terms differ in fate: what a measure leaves unsettled is none of the seven forms; filed as 'shows' (holding the terms shows no fate). generation_degenerates_iff is an iff between a statement of the members and an amount (a later cohort's size is zero), filed as border. not_all_degenerate_while (a 'cannot' theorem, a corollary) is left out by the limit of six.

cards.plain_en: A line that goes on never overdrew what it depends on; so its choices fit an order ranking keeping above ending, which does not show that it holds one.
cards.plain_zh: 延续下来的世系从未透支它所依的存量；所以它的选择合乎“守先于亡”的次序，但这并不表明它持有这样的次序。

cast.as: a line of descent that persists: past every step some cohort has a member
the members of its cohorts
every member of every cohort, depending on some condition of the family at a need of at least m
cast.lean: coupled : ∀ s p, p ∈ G.family s → ∃ e, e ∈ ds ∧ W.requires s p e ∧ m ≤ W.need s p e

cast.as: a family of conditions and its stock
the flow's uptake from the family
the flow's replenishment of the family, gated on the family at a need of at least m
a strict order according with the choices
the alternatives open at an occasion: courses that end what the line depends on and courses that do not; the own continuation among listed items
cast.lean: ChoiceOccasions α O; ends : α → Prop

ties.as: an overdraw: the family's uptake above its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m
whatever gives to the family depends on it at a need of at least m (gated)
every member of every cohort depends on the family at a need of at least m
the line persists: members in arbitrarily late cohorts; a cohort with no member stops it
an order according with the choices puts keeping above ending on the occasions met, or is increasing in its own continuation there

laws.sameness: overdrawn from a short stock, or not
laws.then_en: At no step did the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n plus the need.
laws.then_zh: 从未有过这样的 n 步：取多于补，而起始存量低于 n 加所需。
laws.evidence: (persists : G.Persists) (T n : Nat) : ¬ ((∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) ∧ W.stock ds T < n + m) (Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean)

laws.sameness: ranked above or below, among alternatives met at one occasion
laws.then_en: Some strict order according with the choices ranks every alternative that does not end above every ending one met with it.
laws.then_zh: 有一个与诸选择相合的严格次序，把不致亡的选项排在与它同场出现的致亡选项之上。
laws.evidence: ∃ P : «际» α, (∀ x, ¬ P x x) ∧ (∀ x y z, P x y → P y z → P x z) ∧ ch.Accords P ∧ ∀ x y, ch.Met x y → ¬ ends x → ends y → P x y (Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean)

laws.sameness: increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met, or not
laws.then_en: Some strict order according with the choices is increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met together.
laws.then_zh: 有一个与诸选择相合的严格次序，在同场出现的各对选项上随自身的延续而升。
laws.evidence: ∃ P : «际» (Y → Bool), (∀ a, ¬ P a a) ∧ (∀ a b c, P a b → P b c → P a c) ∧ ch.Accords P ∧ Weighting.IncreasingInOwnOn ch.Met items own (fun b a => P a b) (Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean)

laws.sameness: a cohort with a member, or none
laws.then_en: Past the window, a cohort depending on the family leaves the next cohort with no member: the line stops there.
laws.then_zh: 窗口之后，依这一族存量的一代，其下一代没有成员：世系止于此。
laws.evidence: (excess : ∀ k, k < n → L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)) (start : W.stock ds T < n + m) (k : Nat) (coupled : …) (y : X) : ¬ y ∈ G.family (T + n + k + 1) (Becoming/GroupEnding.lean)

laws.sameness: standing above in every strict order according with the choices and increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met
laws.then_en: One course stands above another in every such order exactly where it reaches the other in the shown relation with every own-widening met added.
laws.then_zh: 一个选项在所有这样的次序里都在另一个之上，恰在它经“所示关系加同场的自身扩展”及于后者之时。
laws.compare_en: standing above in every consistent order increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met, against reach in the relation the choices show with the own-widenings met added
laws.evidence: (∀ P : «际» (X → Bool), … → ch.Accords P → Weighting.IncreasingInOwnOn ch.Met items own (fun b a => P a b) → P x y) ↔ «及» (ch.withPairs (ch.OwnWidensMet items own)).Shown x y (Becoming/FromTheDynamics.lean)

laws.sameness: held by a finite listing, or not
laws.then_en: No finite listing of steps and formations holds what the web's actual levels admit.
laws.then_zh: 没有哪份步与形成的有限清单，装得下这张网的实际水平所容纳的。
laws.evidence: (descended : SelectionTerm.Flow.Descended L W G) (persists : G.Persists) (items : List (Nat × X)) : ¬ W.ListsAdmitted items W.level (Becoming/PersistingChoices.lean)

built_cases.shows_en: A persisting line picks itself as is over one more child: no consistent order is increasing in its own continuation.
With every course met and no choice ending, no consistent order is increasing in its own continuation on every pair.
Two formations standing in turn: the line persists, never overdraws, and keeps; an order increasing in its own continuation fits.

cards.misfit: The theorems on choice conclude that some strict order consistent with the choices exists (or that every such order ranks a pair): what choices are consistent with, not that a rule is held or that a tie begins, lasts, changes or ends; filed as 'shows'. selfConcerned_above_iff_reach is an iff in the reach of a relation, not in amounts or times; filed as border. The choices meet the draw only through a supplied premise (an ending pick is realized as an overdraw): that bridge is no tie of the web. reversed_off_met (off the occasions met a consistent order is free) is an existence of an order and is left out by the limit of six.

cards.plain_en: A line carries a reading and acts by it; whether the line still stands late on is unmoved by what the reading says beyond what couples into the line.
cards.plain_zh: 世系带着一种读法、照它行事；它到后来还在不在，不为这读法对耦合所不及之处怎么说所动。

cast.as: the line read off a flow from founders and a listing; its slots
cast.lean: L.lineOf W members first; StandsLate slots

cast.as: the members of its cohorts
the reading each relatum carries and the act that reading gives

With nothing coming back, the line's slots stand late when it clears the habitat exactly as when it spares it.

cards.misfit: Standing late is taken as the selection though nothing picks: it is a property of one course read off the slots' couplings, so 'rule', 'read-through' and 'reaches' hold it only loosely. carried_keeping_above_ending concludes that some order consistent with the choices exists, not that a rule is held; filed as 'shows'. levels_of_follows identifies a given flow's levels with the levels a law generates: one course under two descriptions, filed as same-as; inheritsReading_iff is a definitional re-reading of inheritance as revision, also same-as. The reading here has no 'what it is of': it only indexes an act, and which act each reading gives is supplied. Persisting implies standing late (lineOf_standsLate), not conversely; that theorem is left out as neither a main result nor an exit.

cards.misfit: share_step is Price's equation read for a region's count: an identity between amounts with no condition, holding of every generations; no form states an equality, so it is filed as border with frame every-course, and its strength is 'sufficient' only by the rule for a theorem that is no iff (it has no premise to be sufficient for anything). absent_step and carriers_drawn_down conclude an equality of counts (next carriers = revisions in), which no mark states. absent_step is marked 'absent' for what its first conjuncts state (selection proper on the region is none at that step); its use, that an absent region begins again only by revision in, is a reading of the equality and is not stated as a beginning. carriers_drawn_down is marked 'ends' as the equality's reading (no carrier at the next step descends from a carrier). kept_iff is an iff in closure under descent, not in amounts; filed as tie with strength exact. standingCount_unselected compares two acts of a part, not two readings: 'reaches' from the reading is the docstring's gloss. The lock here is a region closed under revision, not the lock of a rule reading the share it selects. The reading is carried by the slot a member stands in, so revision while a member goes on standing is not in the model. The compose entry to the-lock-draws-its-readers-out is joined in words only: no joint theorem. fixed_of_present and closedFrom_of_standing (the lock under copying from what is present or standing) are left out by the limit of six.

cards.misfit: Every theorem is of one supplied construction on the periphery (two practices, a condition of three Boolean coordinates, a fixed starting account and schedule; propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice), not of any type. cycles_iff holds of every account and every number of cycles under the construction's cycle rule, so it is framed one-course. The other three hold of the fixed schedule from the fixed start (the bounds five and two come from the starting account ⟨10,8,0⟩) and are framed built-case, though each is an iff over the construction's conditions, which a witness is not: no frame says 'exact within one built construction'. The 'thresholds' of completed_isSome_iff and better_iff are in two Boolean coordinates, not amounts or times; filed as border. The goal is neither a rule nor a reading cleanly: operation consumes it, the selector's feedback forms it, assessment with response revises it; response and authority are supplied switches that fill no role. The comparison is the construction's own definition, so better_iff states the construction's ranking, not a consequence of the counting law.

cards.misfit: The theorems' conditions are properties of a sameness itself: that a class holds a member's effects, or is constant up to the net's end at the member's class. 'Reaches' here is the root's (on the line under the class), not the tie 'reaches' (a difference coupling in). The iff is of two properties, not of amounts or times: set as tie with strength exact, not border. «亡而网续则后不皆续» concludes a negated 'all' and names nothing that is off the line: set as cannot, with no mark.

cards.misfit: The core theorems are of a relation at rest: no step and no course. 'two-courses' stands for the same links with and without one link, and 'ends' for 'apart once that link is removed'; no theorem says which link is cut or when, though the atlas marks no dropped premise. Lying within one closure is a tie among the parts of one whole with no direction or amount; 'crosses' (closure, boundary) is the nearest kind. 'Needed' is structural (apart without it), not a need at a level, so 'needs' is not used. What a cut returns in the built bodies is computed from a supplied recipe and material; no role kind holds it, and it appears only as built cases.

laws.sameness: a renewal step or not
laws.then_en: No tail of the course, from whatever step, is free of renewal steps.
laws.then_zh: 这条进程无论从哪一步往后，都不会全无更新之步。
laws.evidence: (lowers : ∀ n, ¬ renewal n → rank (r.state (n + 1)) < rank (r.state n)) (start : Nat) : ¬ ∀ n, start ≤ n → ¬ renewal n — Becoming/Labelled.lean:530

laws.sameness: active or not
laws.then_en: The drawer is not active at arbitrarily late steps of the course.
laws.then_zh: 取用者不会在任意晚的步上仍在活动。
laws.evidence: (unrenewed : ∀ t, T ≤ t → K.level (r.state (t + 1)) c ≤ K.level (r.state t) c) (lowers : ∀ t, T ≤ t → K.active (r.state t) f → K.level (r.state (t + 1)) c < K.level (r.state t) c) : ¬ ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ K.active (r.state t) f — Becoming/Labelled.lean:541

laws.sameness: a course without end, or none
laws.then_en: The process has no course without end.
laws.then_zh: 这一过程没有无尽的进程。
laws.evidence: theorem Run.not_of_depletion {P : Process S A} (reserve : S → Nat) (lowers : ∀ s a t, P.step s a t → reserve t < reserve s) (r : Run P) : False — Becoming/Labelled.lean:515

built_cases.shows_en: One start, the drawer active throughout: one course renews, the other consumes, its dependent inactive from step one on.

cards.misfit: The four bounds conclude bare negations (not at arbitrarily late steps; no run; no tail free of renewal). The mark 'ends, from some step on' would say more than the Lean proves without classical logic, so they are set as cannot. Renewing and consuming are classes of a whole course, relative to that course, by definition: no theorem here states them and no mark holds a whole-course class. In Run.renewal_recurs a renewal is any marked step; the theorem does not say the stock is given to there. drawdown_not_recurring concludes of the drawer's activity, not of its drawing: the drawer is known only by its active steps lowering the level (the field draws is not used), so the theorem is set on the role, not on the draws-on tie. falls_not_recurring is of any natural-number observable: 'stock' is the nearest role. not_of_depletion's premise names a reserve that every admissible step lowers, but its conclusion names no role (the process has no run), so about_role is 'any'; its frame is every course of that process, not the legend's.
